purpose.description: "release" flags the result reviewRequired (fillet radii are often stress-relevant) and warns when tolerances were defaulted. Default "design".

require.description: Continuity the blends must reach: "G1" (default; a curvature jump is only an info finding) or "G2" (a curvature jump fails).

samples.description: Points per contact line (2..101). Default 11.

name: check_blends

description: Preliminary wind-bracing check of the steel hall on a level (members with role brace, e.g. from add_portal_frame_building). Longitudinal wind on the gable: ULS force = 1.5 · qp · (0.8 + 0.5) · gable area (span × eaves + roof triangle, from the end-frame rafters/columns). Half goes to the roof level and, with the EN 1993-1-1 §5.3.3 equivalent stabilising force (1/200 of the roof ULS vertical load 1.35 deadLoad + 1.5 snowLoad), is carried by the roof X-bracing as a horizontal truss, shared equally by the braced end bays; the roof reactions go to the wall X-bracing. Diagonals are tension-only: one per X carries the panel shear / cos θ, checked against Npl,Rd = A·fy (γM0 = 1, net = gross for welded ends). The transverse component is carried in compression by the rafter (roof) or column (wall), checked for minor-axis buckling χ·Npl,Rd with Lcr = bay length. Gable posts: net pressure cpe + cpi = 0.8 + 0.2 = 1.0 on one wall, simply supported bending q·tributary·h²/8 vs Mpl and shear. The roof truss spans the full hall width on the two outer walls: panel shear V = w·(W/2 − d) (w = bay force / W, d = distance of the panel edge from the nearest wall), so wall-side panels carry about half the bay force. Struts: wall = column, Lcr = column height; roof = rafter, Lcr = purlin gap along the rafter; plus the eaves purlin carrying the truss reaction (bay force / 2) with Lcr = bay length (row flagged utilisation 99 if absent). On multi-span halls the internal column lines carry no wall bracing, so the roof truss still spans the full hall width and the reaction (bay force / 2) acts at the two OUTER wall lines only: the eaves-strut force equals that of a single-span hall of the same gable area (it grows with the gable, e.g. a monopitch gable is larger than a duopitch one), and a light eaves purlin such as the default C200x75x2.5 over a 6 m bay (about 36 kN) can fail at qp above about 0.7 kN/m²: fit a heavier eaves purlin (update_steel_member) rather than treating the force as an error. Crane longitudinal path (runway beams, role crane, on a long wall): per runway line the force at rail level is max(1.35 HL,i = 1.35 φ5 K/nr of groups 1/5, HB,1/nr of group 7 with accidental γ = 1.0, HB,1 = 1.25 · 0.7 travelSpeed · √(mc SB), crane mass only) and is added to the shear of the wall X-bracing panels on that side (shared equally by the braced bays of that wall; assumes the existing wall X-bracing takes it, no separate crane bracing below the rail). Rows "crane longitudinal (group 1 / group 7)" report the crane-only part; data.crane gives the horizontal force (along y) at the foundations of the braced-bay columns. Rows are grouped (roof bracing, wall bracing per side, gable posts); utilisation > 1 fails. Not covered: frame action, uplift, self-weight, connections - a preliminary check.

bufferStiffness.description: Buffer spring constant SB in kN/m (> 0) for HB,1 = φ7 v1 √(mc SB). Default 1000 kN/m.

craneCapacity.description: Crane capacity in tonnes (> 0) for the crane longitudinal force. Default: read from the runway beam notes (add_crane_runway); no runway and no value = no crane force.

craneSelfWeight.description: Crane self-weight Gc in kN (> 0, bridge + trolley; trolley = 0.2 Gc). Default 0.5 Q + 20 kN.

deadLoad.description: Roof dead load, kN/m², for the stabilising force only. Default 0.5.

levelId.description: Level id. Default: the active level.

snowLoad.description: Roof snow load, kN/m², for the stabilising force only. Default 0.8.

travelSpeed.description: Crane long travel speed in m/s (> 0) for the buffer force HB,1 (v1 = 0.7 × travelSpeed). Default 0.63 (about 38 m/min).

windPressure.description: Peak velocity pressure qp, kN/m² (EN 1991-1-4). Default 0.6. Frame gable coefficient 0.8 + 0.5; gable posts use net cpe + cpi = 0.8 + 0.2.

name: check_bracing

description: Read-only pass / warn / fail list over the flow (CFD) cases: runs the prepare_cfd_case checks of every case (watertight, self-intersection, small features, blockage, memory when known, regime) and says whether its recorded result is stale (case or geometry changed since the solve). Use it as the one-call health check of the Flow setup (pass / warn / fail per case, plus result staleness); use prepare_cfd_case for the full report of one case (domain, blockage, grid, memory estimate).

caseIds.description: Cases to check; default every case of the document.

name: check_cfd

description: Read-only clash detection (like Navisworks / Plant 3D): hard clashes between pipes, cable trays, equipment, steel members, walls, concrete columns, beams and stairs (a beam or column through a stair flight, a beam crossing a wall it does not frame into), equipment passing through a floor / grating that has no opening around it (add_slab_opening), a stair whose headroom (2 m above its treads) runs into a slab without a well (add_slab_opening stairId), a door / window opening that overlaps a column in its wall line, plus equipment maintenance-clearance violations. Steel-to-steel joints, a beam ending in the wall or column it frames into, run connections (a pipe end inside equipment, a pipe / tray ending on another) and a pipe support touching its own pipe and the steel it bears on are not reported. Spec-driven pipe runs (route_pipe) take part with their pipe pieces, elbows, valves, flange plates and hubs, tees, olets and reducers (boxes of the circumscribing square of each round part) and with the operator envelope of every valve whose catalogue row describes one (handwheel disc, gear box, actuator along the stem direction; id "<valve part>/wheel", "/gear", "/actuator"): a hit is a hard clash with the part id, e.g. "run-4/pipe-2"; the insulation of an insulated line (create_pipeline insulation, OD + 2 x thickness) is checked too and a hit that the bare pipe clears is kind "insulation"; a run is not checked against the runs attached to it or the equipment its nozzles sit on. Returns element ids, kind ("hard", "insulation" or "clearance") and penetration depth (document units; summary in mm).

levelId.description: Only this level. Default: the whole building.

tolerance.description: Ignore penetrations up to this depth, in document units (>= 0). Default 5 mm.

name: check_clashes

description: Read-only geometric continuity of joints, in numbers (not a picture). Each pair joins two nurbs_curve entities (the nearest pair of ends is compared) or two nurbs_surface entities (one boundary edge of each, `side` "u0" | "u1" | "v0" | "v1", detected when omitted; sampled `samples` times along the first edge). Measured: G0 position gap (document units); G1 angle between tangents / surface normals (radians); G2 jump of curvature (curves: the curvature vectors; surfaces: the normal curvature across the edge) with its relative size; G3 the jump of d(curvature)/ds (surfaces: of the rate of normal curvature across the edge, one-sided into each patch). `order` is the highest level within tolerance: "none", "G0", "G1", "G2" or "G3". Tolerances default to g0 = 1e-6 x the size of the entities, g1AngleRad 0.01 rad, g2Rel 0.1 (10 %), g2Abs 1e-9, g3Rel 0.1 and are reported with the names that were defaulted. `require` makes `pass` false unless every joint reaches that order. Reference: a corner is G0, line + tangent arc G1, line + y=x^3 G2, line + y=x^4 G3.

g0.description: Largest position gap still counted as G0, document units (> 0). Default 1e-6 x the entity size.

g1AngleRad.description: Largest angle still counted as G1, radians (> 0). Default 0.01.

g2Abs.description: Curvature difference (1/document unit) below which two curvatures count as equal (>= 0). Default 1e-9.

g2Rel.description: Largest relative curvature jump still counted as G2 (> 0). Default 0.1.

g3Rel.description: Largest relative jump of d(curvature)/ds still counted as G3 (> 0). Default 0.1.

pairs.description: 1..50 joints to check, each between entity `a` and entity `b`.

a.description: First entity of the joint (and its boundary edge for a surface).

id.description: Id of a nurbs_curve or a nurbs_surface entity.

side.description: Boundary edge of a nurbs_surface: "u0" / "u1" = the edge at the lowest / highest u (a curve running along v), "v0" / "v1" = the edge at the lowest / highest v. Omit to detect it (the side pair that meets best).

b.description: Second entity of the joint.

id.description: Id of a nurbs_curve or a nurbs_surface entity.

side.description: Boundary edge of a nurbs_surface: "u0" / "u1" = the edge at the lowest / highest u (a curve running along v), "v0" / "v1" = the edge at the lowest / highest v. Omit to detect it (the side pair that meets best).

require.description: Order every joint must reach for `pass`. Default "G1".

samples.description: Samples along a surface edge, integer 2..201. Default 21. Curve joints are measured at the joint only.

name: check_continuity

description: Grid-convergence check of one scalar result (Celik et al. 2008 procedure, Roache GCI): from 2–12 samples of the same quantity at different mesh spacings h (or element counts with the domain measure), returns the observed order p, the Richardson-extrapolated value (in `unit`), the Grid Convergence Index of the finest sample (GCI21 fine/coarse, a FRACTION of the value: 0.01 = 1 %), GCI32, the asymptotic ratio (≈ 1 in the asymptotic range) and, with gciTarget, the spacing needed to reach it. Classifies first: oscillatory or divergent samples return a code (VNV_OSCILLATORY / VNV_DIVERGENT) and NO extrapolated value. Safety factor 1.25 (≥ 3 levels) or 3 (two levels, needs assumedOrder) as named defaults. Warnings: VNV_ORDER_MISMATCH (|p − formalOrder| > 0.5), VNV_NOT_ASYMPTOTIC, VNV_RATIO_TOO_SMALL, VNV_TWO_LEVEL_ONLY. Read-only; next: refine further, or report the GCI as an estimated discretisation error.

assumedOrder.description: Order assumed for a two-sample study (required with exactly 2 samples).

dimension.description: Spatial dimension 1, 2 or 3 for elements -> h.

formalOrder.description: Formal order of the method (e.g. 2 for linear tets in displacement).

gciTarget.description: Target GCI21 as a fraction (0.01 = 1 %): adds requiredSpacing and a check.

measure.description: Domain length, area or volume (unit^dimension) when samples give elements.

quantity.description: What was measured, e.g. "tip u_y" or "max von Mises at the lug".

safetyFactor.description: GCI safety factor Fs. Default 1.25 (≥ 3 samples) or 3 (2 samples).

samples.description: Samples in any order (sorted finest first). At least 3 for a full study; 2 only with assumedOrder.

elements.description: Element count; with measure + dimension gives h = (measure/elements)^(1/dimension).

h.description: Representative mesh spacing (any consistent length unit); > 0, distinct per sample.

value.description: The quantity at this spacing, in `unit` (finite).

unit.description: Unit of every sample value, e.g. 'mm', 'MPa', '1' (dimensionless).

name: check_convergence

description: Preliminary check of the crane runway beams (steel members with role crane, from add_crane_runway / add_portal_frame_building crane) of a level. Each segment between supports is a simply supported beam (conservative vs continuous) loaded by one 2-wheel crane group per rail: wheel load P = max rail reaction / 2 from the statics of the bridge with the trolley at the minimum hook approach (EN 1991-3 load group 1: φ1 = 1.1 on Gc, φ2 by hoisting class), lateral rail force = envelope of the transverse drive force HT (group 1, φ5 = 1.5) and the skewing force HS (group 5, §2.7.4, α = 0.015) split on the wheels, longitudinal stop force HL = φ5 K/nr as axial force, ULS factor 1.35, runway + rail self-weight (railSize). Checks: (1) strength - biaxial My/Mpl,y + Mz/Mpl,z with lateral bending carried by the top flange only (Wpl,z/2), and shear; (2) ltb - χLT from Mcr (C1 = 1.13, Lcr = span, I-sections only, 0.85 Mcr for the top-flange load application); (3) SLS EN 1993-6 §7.3 - vertical and lateral deflection <= L/600 under characteristic wheel loads (static P, two-wheel exact midspan formula); (4) fatigue EN 1993-1-9 - ΔσE2 = λ φfat Δσ at the bottom flange, λ = 0.315 / 0.397 / 0.500 (normal stresses, EN 1991-3 Tab. 2.12) for class S2 / S3 / S4, φfat 1.05, detail category 71, γMf 1.15, γFf 1.0. (5) local - EN 1993-6 §5.7.1: leff = 3.25 (Irf/tw)^(1/3), Irf = 0.75 Ir(rail, wear) + If (rail not rigidly fixed, Tab. 5.1 case b), beff = foot + hr + tf <= b, σoz = 1.35 P / (leff tw) <= fy/γM0; local fatigue with λ x 1.26 (2 cycles per passage), φfat 1.05, category 160 (girder rolled) / 71 (welded-full, full-penetration) / 36 (welded-fillet) / γMf 1.15. (6) buffer forces, load group 7 (§2.11.1): HB,1 = φ7 v1 √(mc SB), φ7 = 1.25 (ξb ≤ 0.5), v1 = 0.7 travelSpeed, mc = crane mass (free hook), SB = bufferStiffness; shared by the 2 rails, accidental γ = 1.0 (Tab. A.1); rows: stop force vs top-flange weld transfer (b tf fy, stop welded to the top flange) and end-bay axial + bending at the beam centroid (eccentricity h/2 + rail height). (7) test load, group 8 (§2.10): Qtest = max(φ6 · 1.1, 1.25) Qh, φ6 = 0.5 (1 + φ2), γ = 1.1, bending row. Utilisation > 1 fails. Not covered: torsion, rail-wheel contact, continuity, connections - not a substitute for the engineer of record.

bufferStiffness.description: Buffer spring constant SB in kN/m (> 0) for HB,1 = φ7 v1 √(mc SB). Default 1000 kN/m.

craneCapacity.description: Crane capacity in tonnes (> 0) applied to every runway beam. Default: read from each runway beam's note (add_crane_runway capacity).

craneClass.description: EN 1991-3 / EN 1993-6 fatigue duty class (S2 light, S3 medium, S4 heavy). Default S3.

craneSelfWeight.description: Crane self-weight Gc in kN (> 0, bridge + trolley; trolley = 0.2 Gc). Default 0.5 Q + 20 kN.

craneSpan.description: Bridge span between the two runway rails, mm (> 0). Default: x distance to the paired runway beam, else 20000.

girder.description: Runway girder type for local web fatigue (EN 1993-1-9 Tab. 8.10): rolled section = detail category 160; welded-full = welded plate girder with full-penetration web-to-flange welds = 71; welded-fillet = fillet or partial-penetration welds = 36. Default rolled.

hoistingClass.description: EN 1991-3 hoisting class for the dynamic factor φ2 = φ2,min + β2 vh (HC1 1.05 + 0.17 vh, HC2 1.10 + 0.34 vh, HC3 1.15 + 0.51 vh, HC4 1.20 + 0.68 vh). Default HC2.

hoistingSpeed.description: Hoisting speed vh in m/s (>= 0) for φ2. Default 0.1.

levelId.description: Level id. Default: the active level.

minHookApproach.description: Minimum approach of the hook to a rail in m (>= 0): the trolley position that maximises the wheel load. Default 1.0.

railSize.description: Crane rail (DIN 536 Form A, approximate section data, or flat bar 50x30). Its mass joins the runway self-weight and its inertia (75 % of Ir for wear) spreads the wheel load in the local web check. Default A55.

travelSpeed.description: Crane long travel speed in m/s (> 0) for the buffer force HB,1 (v1 = 0.7 × travelSpeed). Default 0.63 (about 38 m/min).

wheelBase.description: Wheel base a of a crane rail wheel group (distance between its two wheels) in mm (> 0), used for the transverse drive force HT = φ5 ξ M / a. Default 3000.

name: check_crane_runways

description: Readiness / review check of a crack-growth case: models and histories resolve, data verified, scatter factors set, detectable size given, K at aInitial below Kc, growth rates inside the data range, marginal band set, disposition pending. Returns data { status pass | warn | fail, items[{ code, severity, ids, message, remediation }], reviewRequired: true }. Run it last.
name: check_damage_tolerance

description: Pass / warn / fail verdict for deformed bodies, with coded findings an agent can act on. Checked: fold-over (min det J <= 1e-6, DEF_CHECK_FOLDOVER), self-intersection and open edges of the result (DEF_CHECK_SELF_INTERSECTION, DEF_CHECK_NOT_CLOSED), chordal deviation above the tolerance (DEF_CHECK_APPROX_ERROR), the result volume against the volume predicted from det J (DEF_CHECK_VOLUME_DRIFT; independent proof the result is what the law describes), crease at a linear region end (DEF_CHECK_REGION_CREASE, warn), faceted mesh result (DEF_CHECK_MESH_RESULT, warn). Each finding has the entity id, the value and the limit with its unit, and the fix. data.tolerances lists every limit with its source (a named default is also reported as DEF_CHECK_TOLERANCE_DEFAULTED); data.unverified is true when an input is an unpinned imported mesh (DEF_CHECK_INPUT_UNVERIFIED, never suppressible). purpose "release" on a mesh result or unverified input sets data.reviewRequired with the reason. Lengths in document units. Read-only: end every deformation job with it.

approx.description: Largest acceptable chordal deviation, document units. Default: the tolerance the deformation was run with.

creaseRad.description: Largest acceptable crease angle at a linear region end, radians. Default 0.01.

ids.description: Ids of the deformed mesh entities to check. Default: every entity whose recipe has a deform node.

purpose.description: "design" (default): a faceted result is only a warning. "release": a faceted result or an unverified input also sets reviewRequired.

volumeDriftRel.description: Largest acceptable relative difference between the result and predicted volume, unitless. Default 1e-4 for an exact result, 5e-3 for a mesh result.

name: check_deformation

description: Evaluate the `check` lines of the document's design against the current document (after any later edits). Fails with DESIGN_CHECK_FAILED when a check fails (CLI exit 1: use it as a gate). data: { checks[]: { line, metric, of, op, expected, actual, tolerance, pass }, passed, failed }.
name: check_design

description: Check the document colour profiles. Reports VIS_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND (error: the active profile is missing), VIS_COLOUR_UNMATCHED (warn: entities that carry a property the active profile tests but matched no rule; data ids list them), VIS_RULE_PROPERTY_UNKNOWN (warn: a rule tests a property no entity of the document has), and VIS_SCHEME_REVIEW_REQUIRED (warn: the active profile is flagged reviewRequired: no qualified reviewer approved it). data { status: pass|warn|fail, issues[{ code, severity, ids, paths, message, remediation }], counts }. Run it after building a profile and before relying on its colours. Read-only.
name: check_display

description: Hydraulic check of the whole gravity network. Rational-method flows (catchments) and point inflows are accumulated downstream through the pipes; each pipe reports length, slope, design and full-bore (Manning) flow, utilisation, depth ratio, velocity and cover at both ends, and passes or fails against the limits. Modified rational method: Tc at each pipe = max over upstream paths of (manhole `entryTimeMin`, default 5 min, + pipe travel times L/v, v = part-full velocity), intensity from `idf` (i = a/(t+b)^c) or the constant intensity, flow = i * sum(C A) + inflows. A manhole with several outgoing pipes splits its flow by full-bore capacity share. The hydraulic grade line runs upstream from the outfall (most downstream manhole; tailwater `outfallLevel`, default the outlet pipe normal depth): friction slope (Q n / (A R^(2/3)))^2 or normal depth, whichever is higher, plus K v^2/2g at manholes where the pipe is pressurised; pipes get hglUpM / hglDownM / surcharged (HGL above obvert) / flooding (HGL above rim - freeboard); manholes get hglM / flooding. Each pipe row reports tcMin, intensityMmH, sumCAHa, designLps. Returns data { pipes, manholes, failures, diverging, csv }.

freeboardM.description: Required freeboard below the rim in metres (>= 0) before flooding is flagged. Default 0.3.

idf.description: Intensity-duration-frequency curve i = a / (t + b)^c (mm/h, t = time of concentration in minutes) replacing the constant intensity: each pipe uses i at its own Tc (modified rational method). Do not combine with `rainfallIntensityMmH`.

a.description: IDF coefficient a (> 0): i = a / (t + b)^c in mm/h.

b.description: IDF offset b in minutes (>= 0).

manholeLossK.description: Manhole head-loss coefficient K in K v^2/2g (>= 0). Default 0.5.

maxDepthRatio.description: Maximum design flow depth / diameter, 0 to 1. Default 0.8.

minCoverM.description: Minimum cover over the pipe crown, metres. Default 0.9.

outfallLevel.description: Tailwater elevation at the outfall(s) in document units, same datum as invert levels. Default: normal-depth water level of the outlet pipe.

rainfallIntensityMmH.description: Constant design rainfall intensity in mm/h (> 0). Default 50. Do not combine with `idf`.

name: check_drainage_network

description: Review check of the physics model (rigid bodies, joints, motors, propellers): are the inputs realistic and are the simulation numbers trustworthy? Returns the review envelope in data (status = worst item; not_run is never a pass; reviewRequired). Static items need no simulation: FPR_MASS_DEFAULTED (warn; a moving body takes the steel default density 7850 kg/m3 instead of a material, density or massKg), FPR_UNREALISTIC (warn; propeller figure of merit above 0.8, or tip Mach above 0.85 in the run), FPR_NO_LOSSES (warn; no joint damping or friction, spring damper or propeller: the model is lossless), loop topology: FPR_LOOP_PRISMATIC (fail; a loop would close through a prismatic joint), FPR_LOOP_OPEN (fail; pins of a loop further apart than 1 um at the start pose), FPR_REDUNDANT_CONSTRAINT (warn; planar loop with all revolute joints, make one spherical). Simulation self-checks run the same engine as simulate_motion (so they need the physics engine; without it they are not_run, never pass): FPR_LOOP_DRIFT (loop-closure residual, pass <= 1 um, warn <= 10 um, fail above), FPR_ENERGY_CLOSURE (cylinder engines: gas work against the pressure model, gate 0.5 % = fail; otherwise the energy balance of the run, over 0.5 % = warn), FPR_TIMESTEP_SENSITIVE (the run is repeated at half the timestep; warn when the final speed or position of a joint changes by more than 1 %). With no rigid bodies the result is not_run (FPR_NO_MOTION). Reported by their own commands, not here: FPR_REFERENCE_MISMATCH and FPR_OUTSIDE_VALIDATED_RANGE (compare_to_reference), the engine's brake-torque and wrist-pin timestep sensitivity (check_timestep_convergence), FPR_CALIBRATION_FAILED (add_cylinder_pressure calibrate_brake). Approximate: all thresholds are llull named defaults (grade C), the timestep test compares only final joint states, and a run shorter than the motion cycle can hide drift. Read-only. Next: fix warnings, then check_prototype. Computed by llull, not approved: a qualified engineer must review.

duration.description: Simulated seconds of each run. Default 2. Cover at least one full cycle.

sampleRate.description: Recorded samples per second; default as simulate_motion (36 per crank turn for loops). At most 6001 samples per run.

timestep.description: Integration step in seconds of the first run (the second uses half of it, never below 1e-5 s); default as simulate_motion.

name: check_dynamics

description: Check the placed fastener stacks (read-only; end every fastener job with it). Re-measures each stack along its axis and reports FAST_REGRIP_NEEDED when the thickness changed since insertion (re-run select_fastener and re-insert), FAST_LAYER_MISSING / FAST_LAYER_GAP / FAST_AXIS_MISS when the plates changed, FAST_PITCH for rivets closer than 3 D, and FAST_GEOMETRY_REPRESENTATIVE for parts built from placeholder proportions. data.items lists code, severity, stackIds, message and remediation; data.status is pass / warn / fail. No stackIds = every stack.

stackIds.description: Stack ids (fst-…) to check. Default: all stacks in the document.

name: check_fastener_layout

description: Readiness / review check of a fatigue case: scatter factor set, curve present and verified, history valid, mean-stress model sensible, life margin and marginal band (FE case: the current fatigue field and its hot spots). Returns data { status pass|warn|fail, items[{ code, severity, ids, message, remediation }], reviewRequired: true }. Run it last, after compute_fatigue.
name: check_fatigue

description: Preliminary foundation check of the portal-frame columns of a level (read-only; to size and reinforce the pads that fail use design_footings, same inputs), from the characteristic base reactions of the same frame analysis as check_portal_frames (same deadLoad / snowLoad / windPressure / craneCapacity inputs). For every column with a pad footing (location at the column base) and/or a base plate: (1) soil bearing under SLS G+S, G+S+0.6W (either way), G+W, G+C, pressure = (V + footing 25 kN/m³ + backfill 18 kN/m³ above the footing up to the level) / area, with load eccentricity from H × (footing depth + backfill) reducing the width to B′ = B − 2e (Meyerhof) against `soilBearing` (kPa, default 150); (2) uplift EQU, 0.9 × (footing + backfill weight) vs net uplift under 0.9G + 1.5W (only with windPressure > 0); (3) sliding, H vs μ = 0.45 × (V + weights) / γR,h (γR,h = 1.1, EN 1997 DA2) under 1.0G + 1.5 S / W / 1.35 C, with the thrust shared across the frame columns when thrustTie (a tie or slab is assumed to take the gravity thrust, checked against tieCapacity under 1.35G + 1.5S / crane without wind, and the ground slab weight adds its friction, shared per column); (4) base plate: concrete bearing under 1.35G + 1.5S / wind / crane combinations vs fjd = 2/3 × 1.5 × fcd (C25/30, fcd 16.7 N/mm²) over the whole plate area, anchor tension (uplift shared by all bolts vs 0.9 fub As / 1.25) and bolt shear + tension interaction (shear αbc fub As / 1.25 with αbc = 0.44 − 0.0003 fyb, threads in the shear plane, EN 1993-1-8 §6.2.2(7); Ft/1.4), always grade 8.8. Fixed column bases (base plates with fixity 'fixed', add_portal_frame_building columnBase) add the base moment: bearing eccentricity e = (M + H·lever) / (V + W), an overturning EQU row (stabilising 0.9G·B/2 vs destabilising moment) and a 'base plate M+N' row (concrete bearing block fjd, tension anchor bolts Ft = (M − N zc)/z, plate bending; EN 1993-1-8 §6.2.8 simplified; design_portal_frames sizes the plate). Simplifications: pinned bases have no moment, horizontal force taken at the plate level, bending in the smaller footing side, no biaxial effects, no backfill reduction for the column, no friction in the anchor shear check, no footing reinforcement or punching (see design_footings). (5) Elastic settlement of each pad under SLS G+S, s = q B (1 − ν²) Is / Es (net pressure q − 18 kN/m³ × founding depth, i.e. footing + backfill weight replaces excavated soil; Is 0.88 rigid square, ν 0.3, Es = `soilModulus`, default 20 MPa) vs 25 mm, plus the worst differential settlement between adjacent columns of a frame vs L/500. With the optional `clayLayer` the primary consolidation of a clay layer below the footing (5 sublayers, groundwater at the founding level, γ′ = unitWeight − 9.81, σ′0 = 18 kN/m³ × founding depth + γ′ z, Δσ by 2:1 spreading, s = Σ Cc h/(1+e0) log10((σ′0+Δσ)/σ′0), Cr up to preconsolidationPressure and Cc beyond) is added to the elastic settlement (same 25 mm limit, row text gives both parts) and feeds the differential row. Returns one row per check and column (worst combination); utilisation > 1 fails. Not a substitute for a geotechnical or structural engineer.

clayLayer.description: Optional compressible clay layer under the pads, adds primary consolidation settlement to the settlement rows. topDepth: depth of the layer top below the founding level, m (>= 0). thickness: m (> 0). compressionIndex: Cc (> 0). recompressionIndex: Cr (> 0, <= Cc; default Cc/5, used only with preconsolidationPressure). voidRatio: e0 (> 0). unitWeight: bulk kN/m³ (> 9.81, default 19; groundwater assumed at the founding level; σ′0 = 18 kN/m³ × founding depth + γ′·z). preconsolidationPressure: σ′p in kPa (> 0; omit for normally consolidated clay). Required: topDepth, thickness, compressionIndex, voidRatio.

preconsolidationPressure.description: Preconsolidation pressure σ'p in kPa (> 0). Default: normally consolidated.

recompressionIndex.description: Recompression index Cr (> 0, <= Cc). Default Cc/5.

thickness.description: Layer thickness, m (> 0).

topDepth.description: Layer top below founding level, m (>= 0).

craneCapacity.description: Crane capacity in tonnes for every runway on the level. Default: read from the runways (add_crane_runway capacity); 0 = ignore cranes.

craneSelfWeight.description: Crane self-weight Gc in kN (> 0, bridge + trolley; trolley = 0.2 Gc). Default 0.5 Q + 20 kN.

deadLoad.description: Roof dead load (build-up, purlins, services), kN/m². Default 0.5.

hoistingClass.description: EN 1991-3 hoisting class for the dynamic factor φ2 = φ2,min + β2 vh (HC1 1.05 + 0.17 vh, HC2 1.10 + 0.34 vh, HC3 1.15 + 0.51 vh, HC4 1.20 + 0.68 vh). Default HC2.

hoistingSpeed.description: Hoisting speed vh in m/s (>= 0) for φ2. Default 0.1.

levelId.description: Level id. Default: the active level.

minHookApproach.description: Minimum approach of the hook to a rail in m (>= 0): the trolley position that maximises the wheel load. Default 1.0.

soilBearing.description: Allowable (SLS) soil bearing pressure in kPa. Default 150. Must be > 0.

soilModulus.description: Soil elastic (Young) modulus Es in MPa for the settlement rows. Default 20. Must be > 0.

thrustTie.description: true = the frame thrust is carried by a tie (ground slab cast around the columns or tie bars): each frame's columns share the frame's net horizontal reaction for the sliding check and one tie-force row per frame is added. false = every pad resists its own horizontal reaction by friction. Default true when the level has a slab element, else false.

tieCapacity.description: Tie capacity in kN used for the tie-force row (thrustTie only). Default 175 = 2 × H16 B500 bars (fyd 435 N/mm²). Must be > 0.

wheelBase.description: Wheel base a of a crane rail wheel group (distance between its two wheels) in mm (> 0), used for the transverse drive force HT = φ5 ξ M / a. Default 3000.

windPressure.description: Peak velocity pressure qp, kN/m² (EN 1991-1-4; e.g. 0.6–1.0). Default 0 = wind not applied. Coefficients: walls cpe +0.8 / −0.5, roof −0.6 (monopitch roofs, EN 1991-1-4 Tab. 7.3a zone H: −0.6 with wind on the low eaves, −0.8 on the high eaves), each with internal pressure cpi +0.2 and −0.3.

name: check_foundations

description: Check an implicit body (id from create_implicit_body) for printing / release: mesh closed and edge-manifold, enclosed voids that powder or resin cannot leave (IMP_TRAPPED_VOID, with void volume and a point inside), more than one solid component (IMP_DISCONNECTED), features thinner than 2 voxels (IMP_CHECK_RESOLUTION_COARSE: halve the voxel), and walls / struts below the process limits you give. llull ships NO printer table: pass process {minWallMm, minStrutMm, source} from your machine data sheet, otherwise IMP_CHECK_NO_PROCESS_LIMITS is always reported. purpose "release" marks the result reviewRequired: computed by llull, not approved, a qualified engineer must review. Returns status pass / warn / fail and a findings list.

id.description: Id of the implicit body (the entity id returned by create_implicit_body).

process.description: Process limits in millimetres, from your machine data. Never defaulted.

buildDirection.description: Build direction [x, y, z] pointing away from the plate; with criticalAngleDeg it enables the overhang analysis.

criticalAngleDeg.description: Smallest self-supporting inclination of a face to the build plate in degrees (0..90), from your process data; required with buildDirection (never defaulted).

minPoreMm.description: Smallest printable pore / channel in millimetres (measured by the distance transform, +-2.5 voxels).

minStrutMm.description: Smallest printable strut diameter in millimetres.

source.description: Where the limits come from (machine data sheet, owner-supplied...). Required: limits without a source are not accepted.

purpose.description: design (default) or release; release adds the review-required statement.

name: check_implicit

description: Check the laminate design rules on the stack of every zone of a composite part (or of the whole ply list when it has no zones): R1 symmetric (CMP_RULE_R1_SYMMETRY), R2 balanced (CMP_RULE_R2_BALANCE), R3 minimum fraction of plies in each of the 0 / +-45 / 90 families, default 10% (CMP_RULE_R3_MIN_FRACTION), R4 at most 4 consecutive plies of one angle (CMP_RULE_R4_MAX_CONSECUTIVE), R5 outer plies +-45 (CMP_RULE_R5_OUTER_PM45), plus CMP_RULE_DISORIENTATION when maxAngleChange is set. Thresholds come from set_laminate_rules and may be overridden per call in `thresholds` (minFraction is a fraction 0..1, maxAngleChange degrees); the result lists every threshold with its source and whether it is a default (common published guidelines, not CMH-17 clauses). data.status is "pass" or "fail"; each finding has zone, ply indices, value, limit, unit and a remediation. Read-only.

thresholds.description: Per-call overrides of the part rules.

maxAngleChange.description: Maximum angle change between adjacent plies, degrees.

maxConsecutive.description: R4 maximum consecutive plies of one angle (plies).

minFraction.description: R3 minimum fraction (0..1) of plies per family.

items.description: Zone id or name.

name: check_laminate_rules

description: Closing check of a composite part: aggregates the design rules R1-R5 of every zone stack, blending feasibility and ramp conflicts (CMP_RAMP_CONFLICT), the first-ply failure strength ratio under the given load cases (CMP_FPF_RATIO_BELOW_ONE when below 1), and material verification (CMP_MATERIAL_UNVERIFIED for mean / unknown data, never suppressible). Each finding has a code, severity (fail / warn), the offending ids, value / limit / unit and a remediation; data.status is the worst of them. `purpose` "release" also reports defaults in force (CMP_DEFAULT_USED), evaluates rules even if they were disabled, and sets reviewRequired. A failing finding with a requested waiver (request_layup_waiver) stays a failure with waiverStatus "pending" until a human approval exists. Loads are Nx, Ny, Nxy in N/mm and Mx, My, Mxy in N*mm/mm. Run it as the last step of every layup. Read-only.

loads.description: Load cases to check the strength ratio against; omitted = no strength check.

name.description: Load case name.

thresholds.description: Per-call overrides of the part rule thresholds.

maxAngleChange.description: Maximum angle change between adjacent plies, degrees.

maxConsecutive.description: R4 maximum consecutive plies of one angle (plies).

minFraction.description: R3 minimum fraction (0..1) of plies per family.

name: check_layup

description: Check the holes and pockets of a part against machining rules and return findings with stable codes: countersink knife edge (FTR_CSK_KNIFE_EDGE: cone depth >= local thickness), thin land (FTR_CSK_LAND_BELOW_MIN), hole depth / diameter ratio (FTR_HOLE_DEPTH_RATIO_HIGH) and pocket corner radius below the cutter radius (FTR_POCKET_CORNER_BELOW_TOOL_RADIUS). Holes and pockets come from add_hole / add_pocket, or are recognised from the B-rep of an imported solid. Thresholds are data you pass in rules ([{ rule, value, source }]); a rule whose threshold is missing is skipped and reported (rulesSkipped, FTR_RULE_THRESHOLD_MISSING), never assumed. The local material thickness at each hole is measured by a ray cast along the hole axis, unless you give thickness (document length unit). Waivers are accepted only with a human-signed approval record, which does not exist yet: a waiver leaves the finding failing and adds FTR_WAIVER_NOT_APPROVED. Lengths in the document length unit, angles in degrees. Query: exit 0 even when findings fail; data = { status, findings, rulesApplied, rulesSkipped } + units + reviewRequired (computed by llull, not approved).

id.description: Id of the 3D solid to check.

rules.description: Thresholds, one entry per rule { rule, value, source }. A rule you omit is skipped and reported (a later entry replaces an earlier one).

rule.description: "minLand": minimum cylindrical land under a countersink (thickness - cone depth), in document length units; "maxDepthRatio": maximum hole depth / diameter ratio, dimensionless; "toolDiameter": cutter diameter for the pocket corner check, in document length units.

source.description: Where the value comes from (standard, handbook, company rule): mandatory.

value.description: Threshold value, in the unit of the rule (document length units, or dimensionless for maxDepthRatio).

thickness.description: Local material thickness override, in document length units; replaces the ray cast at every hole.

waivers.description: Requested waivers; none can be honoured without a human-signed approval record.

approvalRef.description: Id of the human-signed approval record that accepts the finding.

ids.description: Ids the waiver covers (feature ids of the finding).

name: check_machining

description: Readiness check of the material models and constitutive sets of the document (or of the listed materials): elastic positive definiteness and Poisson bounds, hyperelastic initial modulus and Drucker stability (MATL_HYPERELASTIC_UNSTABLE: error inside the declared stretch validity, warning outside), hardening curves, Prony and creep parameters, missing validity ranges (MATL_VALIDITY_MISSING), set combination rules (MATL_COMBINATION_INVALID), inconsistent monotonic / cyclic Ramberg-Osgood (MATL_RO_FORMS_DIFFER) and, with target, whether every set can be exported to that solver (MATL_EXPORT_UNSUPPORTED, MATL_INCOMPRESSIBLE_DEFAULT). data.stability holds the pivot / Drucker reports per model; data.unverified lists models with the reasons they are unverified. Read-only; run it before handing a law to the owner or a solver.

material.description: Only these material ids (default: every material with material models).

target.description: Also check that every constitutive set can be written for this solver.

usedBy.description: 'analyses': only sets an analysis uses (no analyses exist yet: nothing is checked); 'all' (default): every set.

name: check_material_models

description: Readiness check of the materials in use (read-only): unverified values the mass or allowables rest on (MAT_VALUE_UNVERIFIED: typical, supplier_unstated, unspecified basis or legacy density), records from superseded sources (MAT_SOURCE_SUPERSEDED), private-library records without values on this machine (MAT_LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED), two preferred values on one key (MAT_PREFERRED_CONFLICT), export-controlled records (MAT_EXPORT_CONTROLLED: ITAR / EAR content is refused by every export), and fastener parts built from placeholder geometry (FAST_GEOMETRY_REPRESENTATIVE). Each item has code, severity, ids, message and remediation. Run it before handing a weight or margin to the owner.

entityIds.description: Only the materials of these entities (default: every entity of the document).

name: check_materials

description: Degrees of freedom (mobility) of the mechanism, from the kinematic joints (add_joint, doc.joints; instances are the bodies, one per connected group is the ground) and from the rigid-body dynamics model when it has joints (fixed bodies are the ground; revolute and prismatic joints remove 5 freedoms, spherical 3; gear couplings and drive relations remove 1 each). It is a Grubler-Kutzbach count: redundant constraints make the real mobility higher than the count, so a result is conservative, not a proof. Items: FPR_MECH_LOCKED (fail, mobility <= 0: nothing can move), FPR_MECH_UNDERCONSTRAINED (warn, mobility greater than the number of drives = motors or drive relations: parts move freely), FPR_MECH_OK (pass), with values { mobility, bodies, joints, drives }. No joints at all gives status not_run with FPR_MECH_NONE. status is the worst item (fail > not_run > warn > pass). Read-only. Next: add_joint / add_drive_relation / add_motor to fix the findings, then check_motion_clearance. Computed by llull, not approved: a qualified engineer must review.
name: check_mechanism

description: Pass / warn / fail verdict for one or more meshes (or 3D solids) for a purpose: "print" (closed, manifold, consistently oriented, no crossing triangles, no degenerate faces, optional minimum wall thickness), "boolean" (same minus wall), "fit" (closed, right-side-out) or "export" (warnings only). Each finding has a stable code (MESH_CHECK_NOT_CLOSED, MESH_CHECK_NON_MANIFOLD, MESH_CHECK_INCONSISTENT_ORIENTATION, MESH_CHECK_INVERTED, MESH_CHECK_SELF_OVERLAP, MESH_CHECK_DEGENERATE, MESH_CHECK_SMALL_SHELLS, MESH_CHECK_WALL_THIN, MESH_CHECK_TRIANGLES_ABOVE_LIMIT), the entity ids, a location, the measured value and the limit with its unit, and the command that fixes it. data.unverified is true when an input is an unpinned import (MESH_CHECK_INPUT_UNVERIFIED); data.tolerances lists every limit used with its source. Lengths in document units. Read-only: end every mesh job with it.

ids.description: Ids of the meshes (or other 3D solids) to check.

maxTriangles.description: Fail a mesh with more triangles than this.

minWallThickness.description: purpose "print": smallest acceptable wall in document units; the check probes inward from the surface. Omit to skip the wall check.

purpose.description: What the mesh is for; it sets which defects fail, warn or are ignored.

smallShellFaces.description: A shell of at most this many faces counts as a stray piece (when the mesh has several shells). Default 10.

weldTolerance.description: Vertices closer than this (document units) are merged before checking. Default: 1e-6 x bounding-box diagonal.

name: check_mesh

description: Scan the document for geometry defects, structural issues, and parameter errors. Returns a structured issue list in `data` ({ ok: boolean, issues: Issue[] }) — `ok` is true when there are no error-severity issues. Does NOT mutate the document. Useful as a lint pass before or after build_project. Issue codes: degenerate_size (zero/negative box/cylinder/sphere/extrusion/circle/arc/ellipse/cone/torus/wedge/pyramid dimension), open_profile (polyline not closed), insufficient_points (polyline/spline < 2 points), far_from_origin (entity center > farThreshold units from world origin), empty_layer (layer with no entities), orphaned_group_member (group references missing entity id), dangling_dimension_ref (dimension entity references a missing entity id), dangling_reference (constraint/joint/drive relation references a missing entity or joint), parameter_error (a named parameter has an evaluation error), REF_LOST / REF_SPLIT / feature_step_not_applied (a fillet or chamfer step no longer applies: a recorded edge is gone or split; re-pick it with edit_step_params).

farThreshold.description: Distance from world origin beyond which an entity bounding-box center is flagged as a far_from_origin warning. Units match the document units. Default: 1000000.

name: check_model

description: Does the mechanism hit anything while it moves, and how close does it come? Runs the physics simulation (same engine and parameters as simulate_motion), carries every 3D part with its rigid body through the simulated poses and measures, for every pair with at least one moving part, the minimum surface distance at each sample (poses are interpolated between samples so a thin obstacle is not skipped). Reports per pair data.pairs[]: minClearanceMm with the time (s) and crank angle (deg, when crankAxis is given) where it occurs and witness points, plus every collision interval (start / end time and crank angle, overlap volume mm3 and a penetration estimate at the worst pose). Items: FPR_MOTION_INTERFERENCE (fail; parts overlap with volume), FPR_MOTION_CLEARANCE_LOW (warn; closer than clearanceMm), FPR_MOTION_TOUCH (info; contact without volume, e.g. a pin in its bore), FPR_MOTION_ALLOWED (pass; overlap declared with allow_interference), FPR_MOTION_UNDERSAMPLED (warn; a pass may miss a short contact). status is the worst item; not_run is never a pass. data.minClearance is the closest approach among pairs that never overlap or touch. Parts of one rigid body are never compared with each other. Collision intervals are resolved to the sample spacing (data.samples.resolutionS). Limits: a part wholly inside another without surface contact is not detected; kinematic sweeps (motion_study) are not supported, only simulated runs. Read-only. Next: fix interferences or declare them; then check_prototype. Computed by llull, not approved: a qualified engineer must review.

clearanceMm.description: Required clearance in millimetres: pairs closer than this at any moment give FPR_MOTION_CLEARANCE_LOW. Default 0 (off).

crankAxis.description: Id of a revolute joint of the mechanism (e.g. the crank joint) whose angle (deg, 0-360) labels the findings; default none (time only).

duration.description: Simulated seconds. Default 2. Cover at least one full cycle.

ids.description: Focus parts (entity / instance ids): only pairs where at least one part is in this list are checked. Default: every pair.

maxSamples.description: Most coarse anchors probed first (default 4000). Stretches between anchors are skipped only when the part travel proves them clear, otherwise the recorded samples between are checked: this changes the time, not the findings.

pairs.description: "moving" (default): only pairs with at least one moving part. "all": also pairs of parts that never move.

sampleRate.description: Recorded samples per second; default as simulate_motion (36 per crank turn). Higher = finer contact intervals.

timestep.description: Integration step in seconds; default as simulate_motion.

touchToleranceMm.description: Distance in millimetres at or below which surfaces count as in contact. Default 0.001.

name: check_motion_clearance

description: Check a piping spec (read-only) and return pass / warn / fail findings, each with a code, component ids, paths, values and a fix. Passes: coverage (a pipe, elbow, tee, reducer and, for flanged ends, flange + gasket + bolt set at every size: PSC_COVERAGE_GAP), equal-priority overlaps (PSC_AMBIGUOUS_COMPONENT), catalogue references (PSC_CATALOG_UNKNOWN, PSC_CATALOG_ROW_MISSING), branch table completeness (PSC_BRANCH_UNDEFINED), design conditions against the spec rating (PSC_PT_RATING_EXCEEDED with the rating, margin and values in bar; PSC_TEMPERATURE_LIMIT), dimensional-standard mixing at butt-weld ends (PSC_DIM_STANDARD_MIXED when EN 10220 pipe meets ASME B16.9 fittings and the end diameters differ more than 1 mm; PSC_DIM_STANDARD_ROUNDING for 0.1 to 1 mm), joint class / facing and weld-end compatibility (PSC_END_INCOMPATIBLE), unverified data (PSC_DATA_UNVERIFIED, never suppressible) and spec status (PSC_SPEC_NOT_APPROVED for draft). Give design { pressureBar | pressure { value, unit }, temperatureC | temperature { value, unit } } (gauge pressure) to check the rating. scope "document" also checks every pipe element against its spec (PSC_PIPE_NO_SPEC, PSC_SPEC_REVISION_STALE, PSC_PIPE_SPEC_MISMATCH). Results are for a qualified reviewer (reviewRequired true). Next: fix with edit_pipe_spec.

design.description: Design conditions to check against the spec rating and temperature limits. Omit to skip the design pass.

unit.description: bar, psi or MPa.

pressureBar.description: Design pressure in bar gauge. Give this or pressure.

unit.description: C or F.

temperatureC.description: Design temperature in degC. Give this or temperature.

scope.description: "spec" (default): the spec alone. "document": also every pipe element against its spec.

specId.description: Spec id to check. Required for scope "spec"; scope "document" without it checks every spec in the document.

name: check_pipe_spec

description: Read-only support-spacing check of every pipe (add_pipe_run) and every spec-driven run (route_pipe; its centreline is piping_takeoff.legs, it is listed under its run id and line number and belongs to the highest building level whose elevation is at or below its lowest centreline point, else to the lowest level) against the standard maximum span of water-filled standard-wall steel pipe by DN (MSS SP-69 Table 3 / ASME B31.1 Table 121.5: DN25 2.1 m, DN50 3.0 m, DN80 3.7 m, DN100 4.3 m, DN150 5.2 m, DN200 5.8 m, DN250 6.7 m, DN300 7.0 m …). Uses the pipe's add_pipe_support supports (only those bearing on steel count), else the beams it rests on. Ends inside equipment (nozzle) or on another pipe are carried; a free end needs a support within overhangRatio × allowed span. Returns data.pipes: one row per pipe { id, mark, line, dn, lengthM, maxSpanM (table), allowedSpanM (table × spanFactor), largestSpanM (actual; when every support is unattached, measured between them), overhangM, supports, unattached, unattachedSupports [{ id, mark, type, atM }], basis ("supports" | "resting" | "nozzles" | "none"), risers, ok, issues, notes }; data.orphans lists pipe supports whose pipe or run no longer exists { id, mark, pipeId, levelId, code: "RTE_SUPPORT_ORPHAN" } (they carry nothing; fix with delete_building_element or re-create the run); data.ok is true only when every pipe passes and there is no orphan. RISERS (runs ≥ 0.5 m steeper than 44° from horizontal) are checked too: risers[] = { fromZM, toZM, lengthM, guides, maxGuideSpacingM, allowedSpacingM, weightKn, weightBy ("carried end" | "clamp" | "elbow support" | null), ok, issues }; they need lateral guides (add_pipe_support type "guide" at a point on the riser, bracketed to steel beside it) at most the span table value apart and at most overhangRatio × span from a free elbow, and their weight carried by an end in equipment, a shoe / anchor clamp on the riser or a support within overhangRatio × span of an elbow; the pipe ok includes its risers. Fix a failing pipe with add_pipe_support (spacing or at points).

levelId.description: Only the pipes of this level id (a spec-driven run belongs to the highest level whose elevation is at or below its lowest centreline point, else the lowest level). Default: every level.

line.description: Only the pipe(s) and run(s) with this line number, e.g. "L-101" or "80-HO-4001-CS150-H50".

overhangRatio.description: Largest overhang of a free pipe end beyond its last support, as a fraction of the allowed span, ≥ 0. Default 0.5.

spanFactor.description: Multiplier on the table span, > 0, e.g. 0.8 for insulated lines or many valves. Default 1.

name: check_pipe_supports

description: Query: check the routed pipe of some lines (all lines when lineIds is omitted; branch and continuation runs attached to them are included) and list what a piping designer would raise. data = { status "pass" | "warn" | "fail", issues [{ code, severity "error" | "warning" | "info", ids, paths, message, detail, remediation }], counts { errors, warnings, infos, byCode }, unverified, reviewRequired, lineIds, runIds, partCount, limits }. Codes: RTE_OPEN_END (a part port connected to nothing: a free run end, an unused tee outlet), RTE_DISCONNECTED_PORT (info; tie-in or nozzle with no run, only when lineIds is omitted), RTE_FITTING_TO_FITTING (zero-length piece), RTE_WELD_SPACING (pipe piece shorter than minWeldSpacing, default max(4 t, 50 mm), named in detail), RTE_SIZE_MISMATCH / RTE_RATING_MISMATCH / RTE_FACING_MISMATCH / RTE_END_TYPE_MISMATCH (two connected ports disagree), RTE_FROM_TO_MISMATCH (line from / to text names equipment the runs do not reach), RTE_DUPLICATE_LINE_NUMBER, RTE_SPEC_UNVERIFIED (spec not approved or catalogue rows not grade A; cannot be hidden), RTE_STUB_IN_REVIEW (reviewRequired), RTE_ADVERSE_SLOPE (a leg rises when its declared slope, or the line slope, says it falls; or the reverse), RTE_FLAT_ON_SLOPED_LINE (a horizontal leg on a line or leg that declares a slope: it does not drain), RTE_POCKET (a low point after a fall or a high point after a rise with no branch leaving down as a drain or up as a vent between the two legs; both legs must declare a slope; or detail.kind "eccentric-invert-step": a flat-on-top eccentric reducer steps the pipe bottom up on a line declared to fall), RTE_NONSTANDARD_FITTING (a trimmed 90 elbow or pipe bend: a reviewer accepts it), RTE_ECCENTRIC_OFFSET (the offset of an eccentric reducer is taken up by the next leg only within the angle tolerance; the sideways residual is dropped), RTE_VALVE_OPERATOR_HEIGHT (handwheel centre higher above its level than maxHandwheelCentreHeight; skipped without that limit, which has no code value and is yours to give), RTE_VALVE_OPERATOR_CLASH (the operator envelope of a valve, from its catalogue row: handwheel disc, gear box, actuator along the stem direction, penetrates a pipe part, insulation or building solid deeper than clashToleranceMm; ids = [valve, other]), and the RTE_* derivation code of a run that no longer derives (an error issue: moved port, missing spec row, leg too short). Does not modify the document. Refusal: RTE_UNKNOWN_LINE. Next: fix the issues with route_pipe / insert_inline_component / delete_pipe_run, or accept the warnings.

clashToleranceMm.description: Deepest penetration of a valve operator envelope into another body that RTE_VALVE_OPERATOR_CLASH ignores, mm. Default 5 (check_clashes).

include.description: Report only these issue codes, e.g. ["RTE_OPEN_END"].

lineIds.description: Line ids to check (affected[0] of create_pipeline). Omit for every line.

maxHandwheelCentreHeight.description: Highest allowed valve handwheel centre above its reference level (the highest building level at or below it, else z = 0), mm. Omit to skip the check.

minWeldSpacing.description: Shortest allowed pipe piece between welds, mm. Default max(4 t, 50 mm) of the piece wall t, named in each issue.

name: check_piping

description: Check a piping catalogue (bundled or imported) against dimensional rules of the standards. Rules: b169.lr90 (B16.9 long-radius 90 degree elbow centre-to-end = 1.5 x NPS +/- 2 mm, NPS 3/4 and up), b169.sr90 (short radius = 1.0 x NPS), b165.hole (B16.5 bolt hole = bolt diameter + 1/8 in), pipe.odMatch (butt-weld fitting end OD equals the ASME B36.10M / EN 10220 pipe OD +/- 0.2 mm), monotonic (OD, centre-to-end and bolt circle do not fall with size), provenance (every value cites a source), verified (values that are not grade A: PSC_DATA_UNVERIFIED). Each issue has a code (PSC_CATALOG_DIM_MISMATCH, PSC_PROVENANCE_MISSING, PSC_DATA_UNVERIFIED), the file path of the value (families.0.sizes.0.centreToEnd), expected and found values and a fix. Results are for a qualified reviewer (reviewRequired true). Next: fix the file and import_piping_catalog with replace:true.

catalogId.description: Catalogue id, or id@version. Default: the bundled llull-open-piping.

name: check_piping_catalog

description: Check the PMI of the document (read-only). Re-resolves every feature on the CURRENT B-rep (so it catches PMI broken by a model edit: GDT_FEATURE_UNRESOLVED, GDT_SURFACE_TYPE_CHANGED) when an OCC kernel is present, else reports resolution "not_run". Built-in logical rules (not quoted from a standard): undefined / duplicate / repeated / too many datums, non-positive zones, MMC or LMC on a non feature of size, Ø zone on a plane, datum references on form tolerances, inverted limits, dangling targets; warnings for unused datums, nominal outside limits, items awaiting engineer review (GDT_REVIEW_REQUIRED) and unverified input. Set requireCoverage to also warn about faces of a toleranced solid no item covers. Returns data { status pass|warn|fail, errors[], warnings[] each { code, pmiIds, message, remediation, paths }, stats { items, reviewRequired, unverified }, resolution, ruleTable }. No customer rule table is built: characteristic and modifier permissions per standard are NOT checked (ruleTable "none").

entityId.description: Only check the items of this solid. Default: all PMI.

requireCoverage.description: true = warn about faces of a toleranced solid covered by no PMI item (GDT_FEATURE_UNTOLERANCED) unless a general note exists. Default false.

rules.description: builtin (default). builtin+table needs a customer rule table, none is installed: it adds an unverified warning.

name: check_pmi

description: Read-only check of the scan workspace (end every scan job with it): missing assets (SCN_ASSET_MISSING), unregistered stations, unverified or unaccepted registrations (SCN_REGISTRATION_UNVERIFIED, listing the as-built runs derived from the cloud), extractions made before the cloud moved (SCN_EXTRACTION_STALE), unverified extractions and those awaiting a reviewer (SCN_REVIEW_REQUIRED). data: { status pass | warn | fail, items [{ severity, code, ids, message, remediation }] }.

cloudIds.description: Clouds to check (default all attached clouds).

name: check_point_clouds

description: Structural check of the steel portal frames of a level. Each frame (rafters in a vertical plane + the columns under them; bases pinned, or fixed when the base plates have columnBase 'fixed') is solved as a 2D frame (direct stiffness, section properties from the profile outline, no root radii) for every EN 1990 combination of dead G (deadLoad + self-weight), snow S, wind W (windPressure, both directions, incl. uplift) and crane C (from add_crane_runway capacity, EN 1991-3 load groups 1 and 5: wheel reactions by statics at the minimum hook approach with φ1 / φ2 (hoisting class) / φ4, transverse drive forces HT (φ5) and skewing forces HS at the brackets; combinations C / C5 with the crane at the left or right rail), with sway imperfections and Horne αcr per storey (all moments amplified by 1/(1−1/αcr) when αcr < 10). Checks: member cross-section (EN 1993-1-1 §6.2), flexural buckling with N–M interaction and lateral-torsional buckling (§6.3; columns full height, LTB between side rails, rafters between purlins, compression flanges assumed fly-braced at purlins / rails), frame sway stability (αcr ≥ 3), end-plate bolt groups (EN 1993-1-8, grade 8.8) and SLS deflections (rafters span/200 under snow, eaves h/150 under wind, rail level h/400 under crane). Returns the worst utilisation per element; values > 1 fail. Bracing, foundations and crane runway beams are checked by check_bracing, check_foundations and check_crane_runways. To resize failing sections use design_portal_frames (same loads; this command never modifies the model). A preliminary design check, not a substitute for the engineer of record.

craneCapacity.description: Crane capacity in tonnes for every runway on the level. Default: read from the runways (add_crane_runway capacity); 0 = ignore cranes.

craneSelfWeight.description: Crane self-weight Gc in kN (> 0, bridge + trolley; trolley = 0.2 Gc). Default 0.5 Q + 20 kN.

deadLoad.description: Roof dead load (build-up, purlins, services), kN/m². Default 0.5.

hoistingClass.description: EN 1991-3 hoisting class for the dynamic factor φ2 = φ2,min + β2 vh (HC1 1.05 + 0.17 vh, HC2 1.10 + 0.34 vh, HC3 1.15 + 0.51 vh, HC4 1.20 + 0.68 vh). Default HC2.

hoistingSpeed.description: Hoisting speed vh in m/s (>= 0) for φ2. Default 0.1.

levelId.description: Level id. Default: the active level.

minHookApproach.description: Minimum approach of the hook to a rail in m (>= 0): the trolley position that maximises the wheel load. Default 1.0.

wheelBase.description: Wheel base a of a crane rail wheel group (distance between its two wheels) in mm (> 0), used for the transverse drive force HT = φ5 ξ M / a. Default 3000.

windPressure.description: Peak velocity pressure qp, kN/m² (EN 1991-1-4; e.g. 0.6–1.0). Default 0 = wind not applied. Coefficients: walls cpe +0.8 / −0.5, roof −0.6 (monopitch roofs, EN 1991-1-4 Tab. 7.3a zone H: −0.6 with wind on the low eaves, −0.8 on the high eaves), each with internal pressure cpi +0.2 and −0.3.

name: check_portal_frames

description: Producibility check of the plies of a composite part: drapes every ply on a doubly curved tool face (sphere cap, nurbs_surface; developable faces are exact with zero shear) and compares the fishnet shear with the material lockingAngle and warningShear. Per ply it reports the maximum shear, nodes over the warning / lock angle, the area over the lock and findings: CMP_PRODUCIBILITY_OVER_LOCK (fail: flat patterns are refused unless allowOverLock), CMP_PRODUCIBILITY_NEAR_LOCK (warning), CMP_DRAPE_LIMIT_MISSING (fail: no locking angle exists for the material; no default is used), with suggested darts or splices at the over-lock regions. `stepLength`, `lockingAngle`, `warningShear` override as in drape_ply. Read-only; computed by llull, not approved.

lockingAngle.description: Locking (maximum) shear, degrees in (0, 90]; default the material lockingAngle (no built-in default exists).

plies.description: Plies to check; default all plies of the part.

items.description: Ply id or name.

stepLength.description: Fishnet cell size, document length units; default the ply drape.stepLength, else the outline diagonal / 200; must be > 0.

warningShear.description: Warning shear, degrees; default the material warningShear.

name: check_producibility

description: Readiness check of the property models of the document (or of the listed materials): piecewise jumps above discontinuityTol (PROP_DISCONTINUITY, default 1e-3 relative), the same source + locator transcribed with different coefficients (PROP_SOURCE_CONFLICT with the max difference over the common range), a positive-only property ≤ 0 somewhere in range (PROP_NONPOSITIVE_IN_RANGE), poor (PROP_FIT_POOR) or unreviewed (PROP_FIT_UNREVIEWED) fits, models without an equation range (PROP_EQUATION_RANGE_MISSING, info), and the list of unverified models with reasons. Read-only; run it before handing a property-based result to the owner.

discontinuityTol.description: Relative jump tolerance at piecewise breakpoints (default 1e-3).

material.description: Only these material ids (default: every material).

name: check_property_models

description: The functional-prototype review in one call: "is this model ready to build and does it work?". Runs, in order, check_assembly (solids, overlaps, floating parts, walls, joints realised), the mechanism mobility (inspect_dynamics rank DOF; check_mechanism for kinematic joints), check_motion_clearance (one simulated run, collisions while it moves), check_dynamics (realistic inputs, loop drift, energy, timestep) and, for engines, check_timestep_convergence and compare_to_reference (when reference data is stored). It stops before the motion checks when a part is invalid or floating, or a loop is open (those checks read not_run with the reason). Returns data { verdict: "blocked" | "ready_for_review", ownerSummary (plain language), checks[] (assembly, mechanism, motion_clearance, dynamics: the review envelope each, items with findingKey and the reviewer disposition joined), staleDispositions, durationS, reviewRequired }. Dispositions (set_review_disposition) are recorded, never applied: an accepted fail reads "fail (accepted)" and keeps the verdict blocked. The simulated duration is two settling cycles plus `cycles` four-stroke cycles at the crank speed (else 2 s). Needs the geometry kernel and the physics engine (without physics the motion checks are not_run). Read-only. Next: fix the fails, record dispositions on the rest, re-run. Computed by llull, not approved: a qualified engineer must review.

clearanceMm.description: Required static and moving clearance between parts, mm. Default 0 (off).

crankAxis.description: Revolute joint whose angle labels motion findings. Default the crank of the first cylinder.

cycles.description: Measured engine cycles (720 deg each) after settling. Default 1.

minWallMm.description: Minimum wall thickness, mm; overrides process.

process.description: Manufacturing process whose sourced minimum wall is the wall threshold (check_assembly).

settleS.description: Settling time before the measured cycles, s. Default two cycles.

name: check_prototype

description: Preliminary check of the roof purlins (role purlin) and side rails (role rail) of the steel hall on a level, e.g. from add_portal_frame_building. Each member is simply supported over its bay (conservative: lapped / continuous purlins are not modelled). Tributary width = half the distance along the slope to each neighbouring purlin (rails: half the vertical distance, ground to eaves at the ends). Roof, per purlin: (1) gravity 1.35 (roofDeadLoad + self-weight) + 1.5 snow on plan, components normal to the slope (× cos pitch), bending with the top flange restrained by the sheeting (χLT = 1); (2) wind uplift 1.5 qp (|cpe| + cpi 0.2) - 1.0 dead, with EN 1991-1-4 duopitch roof zones (pitch about 5-15°): e = min(b, 2h) with b the crosswind dimension and h the ridge height; worst of wind across the ridge (θ = 0°: F -1.7 / G -1.2 / H and I -0.6; F/G within e/10 of the eaves, F also within e/4 of a gable) and along the ridge (θ = 90°, Tab. 7.4b: F -1.6 / G -1.3 / H -0.7 / I -0.6; F and G within e/10 of a gable, F within e/4 of the eaves, H up to e/2); multi-span halls (valleys between roofs, EN 1991-1-4 Fig. 7.10 simplified): spans between two valleys are downwind of the windward span for either wind direction and use zone H/I with cpe × 0.6 for θ = 0°; monopitch halls (no ridge) use EN 1991-1-4 Tab. 7.3a instead: θ = 0° (wind on the low eaves) F -1.7 / G -1.2 / H -0.6, θ = 180° (wind on the high eaves) F -2.3 / G -1.3 / H -0.8 with the zones measured from the low / high eaves, θ = 90° F -1.6 / G -1.8 / H -0.6 / I -0.5; the worst zone touching the member applies to its whole length. The bottom flange is in compression: χLT from §6.3.2.3 for I sections with Lcr = span/2, simplified EN 1993-1-3 §10.1 value for cold-formed C sections (0.6 for spans > 6 m, else 0.75), assuming one row of anti-sag bars at mid-span; (3) shear; (4) deflection under characteristic dead + snow ≤ span/200. Rails: horizontal wind on the strong axis, zones A -1.2 (within e/5 of a gable) / B -0.8 (within e) / C -0.5, with cpi +0.2 (inner flange free and in compression: χLT as for purlin uplift), and pressure D +0.8 with cpi -0.3 (restrained, χLT = 1); bending, shear, deflection under characteristic wind ≤ span/150. Cold-formed C sections use an effective section modulus (EN 1993-1-3 §5.5 / 1993-1-5 §4.4, simplified: flange kσ 4 with 0.9 when λp > 0.673, web ψ -1, lips fully effective, no distortional buckling); weak-axis, torsion and cladding self-weight on rails are not checked. Returns one row per member with its governing check; values > 1 fail. This command never modifies the model: to up-size failing members use design_purlins (same loads). Preliminary - not a substitute for the engineer of record.

levelId.description: Level id. Default: the active level.

roofDeadLoad.description: Roof build-up dead load carried by the purlins (sheeting, insulation, services) per m² of roof, kN/m², >= 0. Purlin self-weight is added automatically. Default 0.3.

snowLoad.description: Roof snow load on plan, kN/m², >= 0. Default 0.8.

windPressure.description: Peak velocity pressure qp, kN/m² (EN 1991-1-4, e.g. 0.6-1.0), >= 0. Default 0.6. 0 = no wind.

name: check_purlins

description: Check, without changing anything, whether the current revision can be released now. Returns status pass | warn | fail, coded findings { code, severity, ids, message, remediation } (state, ECO, approvals, checker independence, effectivity, marking, signature, parameter errors, unverified inputs, title block) and humanActionsNeeded naming who must act. Pass the changeOrder / effectivity / approvals you plan to give to release_item to evaluate them. Read-only; an agent should run this before handing a release to the humans.

changeOrder.description: The ECO you plan to release under.

effectivity.description: The effectivity you plan to set (default: the ECO plan).

items.description: One effectivity range.

from.description: First unit covered (inclusive), of the kind.

kind.description: serial / msn: positive integers; date: YYYY-MM-DD; lot: an id string.

to.description: Last unit covered (inclusive). Absent = open-ended.

name: check_release_readiness

description: Run every sheet-metal design rule the document holds data for on a part and return pass / warn / fail findings (read-only; the exit status stays 0, problems are findings). Rules: minimum bend radius against the imported radius table for the rule material/temper/thickness (FTR_BEND_RADIUS_BELOW_MIN with the table row as source, FTR_BEND_RADIUS_NO_TABLE_ROW, FTR_SHARP_BEND_FORBIDDEN), hole-to-bend and hole-to-edge distance, minimum flange length and bend relief (thresholds come from the rule; a missing one gives FTR_RULE_THRESHOLD_MISSING and is listed in rulesSkipped), and FTR_UNVERIFIED_DATA whenever an unverified table, row or threshold was used. Lengths are in the document length unit. waivers (code, ids, approvalRef) turn nothing into a pass: a waiver needs a human-signed approval record that does not exist yet, so the finding stays fail and FTR_WAIVER_NOT_APPROVED is added. data: { status, findings[{code, severity, ids, value, limit, unit, source, remediation}], rulesApplied[], rulesSkipped[], unverified, unverifiedInputs[], reviewRequired, provenance }. The result is computed by llull, not approved. End every sheet-metal job with this check.

id.description: Sheet-metal part id (returned by add_sheet_metal_base).

waivers.description: Waiver requests. They are honoured only with a human-signed approval (not available yet): otherwise FTR_WAIVER_NOT_APPROVED.

approvalRef.description: Reference of the human-signed approval record that accepts the finding.

code.description: FTR code of the finding to waive, e.g. FTR_BEND_RADIUS_BELOW_MIN.

ids.description: Part / node ids of the finding.

name: check_sheet_metal

description: General EN 1993-1-1 member verification of a steel structure built from add_steel_member (multi-storey process structures, pipe racks, platforms, halls), with the loads derived from the model: self weight, floor slabs (add_slab role floor) with dead + imposed load, equipment operating weight (add_equipment weight, kg), pipes (add_pipe_run, steel + contents; carried by their add_pipe_support supports, else resting on beams) and cable trays resting on beams. ULS 1.35 G + 1.5 Q, SLS G + Q. Beams (role beam, horizontal) are simply supported between end nodes, with floor load shared by the 45° tributary rule and equipment by footprint area per bay; checked for bending (+ lateral-torsional buckling when nothing restrains the top flange), shear and deflection ≤ span/250. Columns are checked per storey segment between beam levels for Npl,Rd and flexural buckling Nb,Rd (Lcr = segment length). Braces (role brace, in an X or Y vertical plane) carry the EN 1993-1-1 §5.3.2 equivalent horizontal forces (notionalFactor × factored vertical load per level), tension-only in X-bracing, with slenderness ≤ 300; the horizontal members of a braced bay are checked as struts. Returns data.members: one row per steel member { id, mark, role, profile, check (governing check), utilisation (1.0 = at resistance), ok, governing (combination), detail, checks, forces } — members that cannot be analysed (profile not in the catalogue, class 4, roles rafter / purlin / rail / crane, inclined columns) appear with check "not analysed", ok false and the reason; data.ok is true only when every member is analysed and passes. data.warnings lists model gaps (equipment on grade, pipes resting on nothing, directions without bracing or moment frames, beam ends bearing on nothing). Beam-column connections are pinned unless a beam declares startJoint / endJoint "rigid" (add_steel_member / update_steel_member): columns and rigidly connected beams in one X or Y vertical plane (a pipe rack bent) are then analysed as a 2D moment frame (column bases pinned or baseFixity "fixed"): 1.35 G + 1.5 Q with the notional forces in both directions, joint moments in forces.jointMomentStart / jointMomentEnd, N + M interaction, storey drift ≤ h / swayRatio, αcr ≥ 3 (moments amplified below 10); data.frames lists them and they count as the lateral system of their direction. A rigid joint to nothing or to a beam, a frame mechanism or a column roll between the principal axes leave the members "not analysed" with the reason. A preliminary check, not a substitute for the engineer of record. See data.loads.assumptions for every load-path rule.

cableTrayWeight.description: Weight of a cable tray including its cables, kg per metre of run. Default 75.

deflectionRatio.description: Beam deflection limit as span / n under G + Q. Default 250 (L/250).

floorDeadLoad.description: Permanent load of floor gratings / finishes, kN/m², on every floor slab (add_slab role floor). Default 0.5.

imposedLoad.description: Imposed load on floors, kN/m² (process-plant floors, EN 1991-1-1 category E-like), applied on the floor area not occupied by equipment. Default 5.0.

levelId.description: Only report the members of this level id. The whole model is always analysed (column loads come from beams on other levels). Default: every level.

notionalFactor.description: Equivalent horizontal force as a fraction of the factored vertical load at each floor level (EN 1993-1-1 §5.3.2 φ0 = 1/200 = 0.005, no αh / αm reduction). Default 0.005.

pipeContentDensity.description: Density of the pipe contents, kg/m³: 1000 = water-filled (default, operating / hydrotest), 0 = empty pipes.

swayRatio.description: Storey drift limit of moment frames as storey height / n under G + Q + notional horizontal forces. Default 300 (h/300).

name: check_steel_members

description: Check a frequency_response / random_response case before and after the solve: data { status ok | warning | error, items [{ code, severity, ids, message, remediation }], state, reviewRequired: true }. Set-up: modes, damping (never defaulted), sweep, base excitation and its constraint, spectrum known and verified, truncation threshold. After fea_solve: stale results, band above 1.5 x the highest kept mode, effective mass below the threshold, grid convergence, and the pending human review.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

name: check_structural_dynamics

description: Pass / warn / fail verdict for a subdivision solid with coded findings: DIR_CHECK_DEGENERATE_FACE (fail: a zero-area cage face), DIR_CHECK_SELF_INTERSECTION (fail: the level mesh crosses itself), DIR_CHECK_SYMMETRY_DEVIATION (warn: declared symmetry violated), DIR_CHECK_LEVEL_MESH_DEVIATION (warn: the level-mesh and limit-surface solids differ by more than `meshVsLimitRel` relative), DIR_CHECK_EXTRAORDINARY (info: vertices of valence other than 4 and n-gon faces). data also has the valence histogram, crease counts, Euler characteristic and genus, data.meshVolume (what mass_properties reports without the exact kernel), data.limitVolumeEstimate (extrapolated limit surface) and, with `exactSeams` true on the exact native kernel, data.limitPatches (patch solid, worst seam gap and tangent angle: seconds on a cage of some dozens of vertices, so it is opt-in), in document units^3. Next: edit_subdivision_cage, set_cage_crease, evaluate_subdivision.

exactSeams.description: true: with the native kernel also sew the exact patch solid and measure its seams (data.limitPatches). Slow (seconds on a 70-vertex level-3 cage); default false.

id.description: Id of the subdivision solid.

tolerances.description: Acceptance limits; omitted ones use the named defaults reported in data.tolerances.

meshVsLimitRel.description: Largest accepted relative difference between level-mesh and limit volume. Default 0.005.

patchSeamAngleRad.description: Largest accepted tangent-plane angle between neighbouring exact patches, radians (exact kernel only). Default 0.05.

patchSeamGap.description: Largest accepted position gap between neighbouring exact patches, document units (exact kernel only). Default 1e-6 x cage diagonal.

symmetry.description: Largest accepted symmetry deviation, document units. Default 1e-9 x cage diagonal.

name: check_subdivision

description: Read-only quality report on nurbs_surface sheets (all of them, or `ids`): one call, numbers and coded findings, no picture. Checks: (1) continuity ACROSS the interior knot lines of each sheet (a crease where the parametric continuity is low) down to the `require` level (G0 position, G1 tangent angle, G2 curvature, G3 curvature rate; default G1, G2 for purpose "release"), measured with the analysis engine of check_continuity; (2) free edges: sheet edges that no other selected sheet shares within `sewing` - a failure when `expectSolid` is true, otherwise informational; (3) with `pullDirection`, draft below `minDraftDeg` or undercuts (see analyze_draft); (4) degenerate samples (poles). Every finding has a stable `code`, severity, entityId, edgeIndex (0..: u knot lines, 100..: v knot lines; free edges 0..3 = u0, u1, v0, v1), value, limit, unit, worst point and a remediation. `status` is "fail", "warn" or "pass". Tolerances you do not give are defaulted and NAMED in `tolerances` with a warning. `purpose` "release" sets `reviewRequired` true: the figures are computed by llull and not approved - a qualified engineer must review them. Not covered here: lofts / wings (section deviation needs the section data) and B-rep faces of the native kernel. Solids and curves in `ids` are listed in `skipped`.

expectSolid.description: The sheets are meant to close a shell: free edges become failures. Default false.

g0.description: Largest position gap still G0, document units (> 0). Default 1e-6 x the size of the sheet.

g1AngleRad.description: Largest angle still G1, radians (> 0). Default 0.01.

g2Rel.description: Largest relative curvature jump still G2 (> 0). Default 0.1.

g3Rel.description: Largest relative jump of the curvature rate still G3 (> 0). Default 0.1.

ids.description: nurbs_surface ids to check (1..200). Omit to check every nurbs_surface of the document.

minDraftDeg.description: Smallest acceptable draft in degrees (-90..90) with `pullDirection`. Default 0 (undercuts only).

pullDirection.description: Optional mould pull direction [x, y, z]: adds the draft check.

purpose.description: "design" (default) or "release" (stricter default level, marks the report as needing human review).

require.description: Continuity every interior knot line must reach. Default "G1" for design, "G2" for release.

samples.description: Samples along each interior knot line, integer 3..101. Default 11.

sewing.description: Distance (document units, > 0) within which two sheet edges count as shared. Default 1e-6 x the size of the sheets.

name: check_surface_quality

description: Read-only check of sweeps and lofts (every sweep and loft when `ids` is omitted; list the ids of swept or lofted sheets to check them too): the frame mode must be defined along the whole path (SWG_CHECK_FRAME_DEGENERATE), the laws finite and positive (SWG_CHECK_LAW_INVALID), and the swept surface must not fold onto itself — at 256 samples the fold margin (path curvature radius / section extent toward the centre of curvature) must stay above `selfIntersectionMargin` (default 1.0; SWG_CHECK_SELF_INTERSECTION_LOCAL). Fitted-face sweeps add an info finding. Returns status pass | warn | fail and findings with code, severity, location t, value, limit, unit and remediation; `tolerances` names every limit with `defaulted` and its `source`. Rail sweeps whose fitted faces miss the rails report SWG_CHECK_RAIL_DEVIATION.
