analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

direction.description: Translation the base moves along.

kind.description: Base input kind: acceleration (the only one in the MVP; displacement histories for transients are V1).

name: set_base_excitation

description: Make one load case of a buckling analysis the PRELOAD, added to the reference load (the first OTHER load case). Without a preload the factors multiply the first load case alone. Omit preloadLoadCase to clear. Needs at least one more load case as the reference load. The CalculiX deck is a *STATIC step with the preload, then a *BUCKLE step that writes preload + reference loads SUMMED (a later *CLOAD / *DLOAD replaces the value at the same node and dof / element face / gravity instead of adding to it). CalculiX 2.21 scales the WHOLE *BUCKLE step load (measured: the stress of the static step is not held as a base state), so the factors multiply preload + reference: the critical load is factor x (preload + reference), NOT preload + factor x reference (analysis_report data.eigen.factorsMultiply). The Nastran BDF export does not support a preload.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

preloadLoadCase.description: Name of the load case (1-40 letters, digits or underscores) that is applied as the constant preload, e.g. "dead_weight". Omit to clear.

name: set_buckling_preload

description: Set crease sharpness on a subdivision solid: `edges` (ids "e:<idA>|<idB>" or [a, b] index pairs, the string "all", or { loopFrom: edge } for the whole edge loop through that edge) and/or `vertices` (corner sharpness) get `sharpness` 0..10: 0 smooth (removes the crease), 1 crisp for one subdivision level, 2 for two levels, 10 infinitely sharp. Fractional values blend (0.5 = half crisp). `method` "uniform" (default) lowers sharpness by 1 per level, "chaikin" smooths the decay. Mirror images follow when the cage has symmetry. Returns data { sharpness, edges (ids), vertices (ids) }. Next: check_subdivision, mass_properties.

items.description: A cage edge: id "e:<vertexIdA>|<vertexIdB>" (stable) or a [vertexIndex, vertexIndex] pair.

loopFrom.description: An edge of the loop; the loop continues straight through valence-4 vertices.

edges.description: Edges to set: a list, "all", or { loopFrom }.

id.description: Id of the subdivision solid.

method.description: Decay of sharpness per level (entity-wide): uniform (default) or chaikin.

sharpness.description: Sharpness 0..10: 0 smooth, 1 one level crisp, 10 infinitely sharp.

vertices.description: Cage vertices whose corner sharpness is set (they stay point-like for about that many levels).

items.description: A cage vertex: element id ("v-1.7", stable across topology edits) or current index.

name: set_cage_crease

description: Declare mirror symmetry of a subdivision solid through entity-local coordinate planes at its origin (planes ["x"] mirrors x to -x). Every vertex is paired with its mirror image within `tolerance` (default 1e-6 x the cage diagonal); later edit_subdivision_cage, set_cage_crease, extrude_cage_faces, inset_cage_faces and loop_cut_cage keep the cage symmetric. `snap` true moves near-mirror vertices onto exact mirror positions first (use it with a larger tolerance to symmetrise a rough cage). Empty `planes` clears the symmetry. Refuses unpaired vertices (DIR_SYMMETRY_UNPAIRED, ids and distances in the summary) and faces without a mirror face (DIR_SYMMETRY_TOPOLOGY). Returns data { planes, tolerance, pairs, onPlane, maxDeviation }.

id.description: Id of the subdivision solid.

planes.description: Mirror planes (entity-local, through the origin); empty clears the symmetry.

snap.description: true: move paired vertices onto exact mirror positions (mean of the pair) and on-plane vertices onto the plane.

tolerance.description: Largest distance (document units) between a vertex and its mirror partner. Default 1e-6 x cage diagonal.

name: set_cage_symmetry

description: Set one or more camera fields (target, azimuth, polar, distance). Unspecified fields are preserved, so target alone re-centres the orbit on a point (optionally with azimuth/polar to also change direction) without changing the distance. target is [x,y,z] world-space orbit centre. azimuth is horizontal angle in radians (XY plane, measured from +Y toward +X). polar is vertical angle in radians (0 = overhead along +Z, π/2 = eye-level). distance is the radius of the orbit sphere; must be > 0. Does NOT add to feature history.

azimuth.description: Horizontal orbit angle in radians measured in the XY plane from +Y toward +X. Eye offset from target is (sin a, cos a) in XY: 0 = eye at +Y (back view), π = eye at -Y (front view), π/2 = eye at +X (right view). Omit to keep current value.

distance.description: Orbit radius — distance from target to camera eye. Must be > 0. Omit to keep current value.

polar.description: Vertical orbit angle in radians. 0 = overhead (along +Z), π/2 = eye-level. Clamped to [0.01, π−0.01] to avoid gimbal lock. Omit to keep current value.

target.description: World-space orbit target [x, y, z]. Omit to keep current target.

name: set_camera

description: Tag a body of a flow case as a boundary: wall, inlet, outlet, symmetry or ground. The tag is document data (replayed). Without faceRefs the whole entity carries the condition (model an intake or a nozzle end as its own entity); with faceRefs only those stable face refs do. An entity or face carries one kind: tagging it with a different kind is refused (CFD_BOUNDARY_CONFLICT); clear tags with update_cfd_case boundaries=[]. Untagged surfaces are walls.

entityId.description: A body of the case (one of its entityIds).

faceRefs.description: Stable face refs of the entity; absent = the whole entity. Non-empty strings.

kind.description: Boundary condition kind.

name: set_cfd_boundary

description: Close an ECR or ECO as rejected or cancelled, with a reason. HUMAN GATE. Implemented records are terminal. An agent caller gets PLM_HUMAN_GATE.

at.description: When the act happened: ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:30:00Z. The host (UI / llull CLI) fills it; commands never read a clock.

by.description: User id doing the act (the host fills it from the authenticated user; an agent cannot override it where the server has named users).

confirmation.description: HUMAN SIGNATURE, required: { alg: "Ed25519", keyId, publicKey, signature, nonce } made by a human with a TRUSTED signing key over this exact act (get the bytes with plm_act_payload, sign them in the desktop app or `llull exec ... --confirm-key KEYID`). An agent has no trusted key: it prepares the act and hands over (PLM_HUMAN_GATE).

id.description: ECR or ECO id.

name: set_change_state

description: Declare the coordinate reference system of the civil model (projected grid), e.g. name "RGF93 / Lambert-93", epsg 2154, verticalDatum "NGF-IGN69". Written to LandXML (<CoordinateSystem>). Keeps an existing site calibration (set_site_calibration).

epsg.description: EPSG code of the projected CRS (positive integer), e.g. 2154.

name.description: CRS name, e.g. "RGF93 / Lambert-93". Must not be empty.

name: set_coordinate_system

description: Set the correlation of random variables (replaces any previous matrix). `names` lists the variables, `matrix` is their correlation matrix (symmetric, ones on the diagonal, off-diagonals in (-1, 1), positive definite). Variables not listed stay independent. For non-normal marginals the correlation is the correlation of the values X (a Nataf transform is applied, so a pair whose correlation is not attainable for its distributions is refused).

matrix.description: Correlation matrix, names.length x names.length, e.g. [[1, 0.5], [0.5, 1]].

names.description: Names of at least two defined random variables, in the order of the matrix rows.

name: set_correlation

description: Store unit rates (price per unit) in the project for estimate_cost. Keys are takeoff keys "<category>.<material>.<unit>" (e.g. "wall.concrete.m3": 180, "door.timber.ea": 450) or wildcards "wall.*.m2", "slab-roof.*.m3" (slab groups: slab-floor, slab-roof, slab-foundation) or "*.concrete.m3". Price ONE unit per category to avoid double counting.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. "EUR". Default kept / "EUR".

rates.description: Map of rate key → price per unit (>= 0).

replace.description: Replace all stored rates instead of merging. Default false.

name: set_cost_rates

description: Set the named factors of a crack-growth case: scatterThreshold and scatterInterval {value >= 1, source} (NO default: ask the owner) and marginalBand. compute_inspection_interval divides the life from aDetectable to the critical size by scatterInterval.

marginalBand.description: Margin band (>= 0) for check_damage_tolerance. No default.

scatterInterval.description: Factor on the inspection interval life (aDetectable -> critical). No default.

source.description: Mandatory source of the factor (regulation, company rule, case input).

scatterThreshold.description: Factor on the threshold life (aInitial -> critical). No default.

source.description: Mandatory source of the factor (regulation, company rule, case input).

name: set_damage_tolerance_factors

description: Change the modal basis of a frequency_response / random_response case: modes (number of modes CalculiX extracts, 1-100), fMaxHz (Hz: modes above it are not used by the llull post-processing) and modalTruncationThreshold (fraction of total effective mass the kept modes must reach per direction, e.g. 0.9 - a company rule, llull has no default; check_structural_dynamics warns below it).

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

fMaxHz.description: Highest frequency of interest in Hz; modes above it are not kept.

name: set_dynamic_basis

description: Set the damping of a frequency_response / random_response case (there is NO default damping). model: modal (ratios [{ fromMode, toMode, zeta }], zeta = fraction of critical, e.g. 0.02), rayleigh (alpha 1/s, beta s: zeta_j = alpha/(2 w_j) + beta w_j/2), rayleigh_from_ratios (zeta1 at f1Hz and zeta2 at f2Hz -> alpha, beta resolved and stored; zeta dips between the anchors and grows outside, analysis_report lists the ratio applied per mode) or structural_material (loss factor eta from the structuralLossFactor property model of each part material, written as *DAMPING,STRUCTURAL; zeta_eq = eta/2 at resonance). Every model except structural_material needs source { citation }. Replaces any earlier damping of the case.

alpha.description: rayleigh only: mass-proportional coefficient alpha in 1/s, >= 0.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

beta.description: rayleigh only: stiffness-proportional coefficient beta in s, >= 0.

f1Hz.description: rayleigh_from_ratios only: first anchor frequency in Hz.

f2Hz.description: rayleigh_from_ratios only: second anchor frequency in Hz (> f1Hz).

ratios.description: modal only: damping ratio per mode range; a later range overrides an earlier one for the modes they share.

toMode.description: Last mode of the range (inclusive, >= fromMode).

zeta.description: Viscous damping ratio, fraction of critical, 0 <= zeta < 1.

source.description: Required except for structural_material: where the damping value comes from.

citation.description: Where the value comes from (test report, standard, company rule); never empty.

grade.description: Source grade: A >= 2 independent sources, B one secondary source, C unconfirmed.

url.description: Link to the source, when there is one.

zeta1.description: rayleigh_from_ratios only: damping ratio at f1Hz.

zeta2.description: rayleigh_from_ratios only: damping ratio at f2Hz (default zeta1).

name: set_dynamic_damping

description: Tune how simulate_motion integrates a loop-closed mechanism (slider-crank, four-bar, engine). Defaults are right for most models; change them when data.loops.tier of simulate_motion is "warn" or "fail" (FPR_LOOP_DRIFT) or the run diverges. timestepS: seconds, or "auto" (default) = min(1 ms, 0.5 deg of crank at the top speed). integrator: "rk4" (default) or "implicitfast". loopTimeConstantSteps (>= 2, default 2): the loop constraints relax over this many timesteps; 2 is the stiffest stable value and keeps light links (rods of a few grams) closed, but resolves the closure so coarsely that a slider-crank torque (0.5 kg piston, 5 g rod) is 0.7 % off: when crank torque accuracy matters use 8 (0.03 %) to 16 (0.01 %), and check data.loops.tier stays "pass". loopImpedance (0 < d <= 0.9999, default 0.9999): closer to 1 = stiffer loop. loopResidualPassM (default 1e-6 m = 1 µm, 5 % of a 0.020 mm pin clearance) and loopResidualFailM (default 1e-5 m): residual tiers. timestepSensitivityGate (default 0.01): reserved for the half-timestep check. Only the given fields change. Next: simulate_motion and read data.loops.

loopResidualFailM.description: Loop residual (m) above which a run fails. Default 1e-5.

loopResidualPassM.description: Loop residual (m) up to which a run passes. Default 1e-6.

loopTimeConstantSteps.description: Loop constraint time constant in timesteps, >= 2 (default 2).

timestepSensitivityGate.description: Relative change gate of the half-timestep check. Default 0.01.

name: set_dynamics_solver

description: Mechanical losses of an engine (friction, FR-FPR-71): a torque on the crank opposite to its rotation, smoothed near zero speed, whose cycle average is FMEP·V_d/(4π) (four-stroke; 2π two-stroke) at the previous cycle's mean rpm, so simulate_motion reports BRAKE torque = indicated - friction, BMEP = IMEP - FMEP and mechanical efficiency (data.engineReport.losses). Models: "chen_flynn" (A + B·p_max + C·n + D·n², give the four constants; 13 % mean error) or "fmep_table" (FMEP against rpm). Both need a `source`; no default constants exist because none were measured for your engine. "component" is refused (FPR_LOSS_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED): its equations are not checked against a primary source. `cylinders` lists the cylinder pressures whose displacement and peak pressure the friction reads; omit = every cylinder on the crank (also those added later). `oilTempFactor` multiplies FMEP (1 = hot oil, about 2.1 cold). Needed before add_cylinder_pressure with heat calibrate_brake. Returns the record id (loss-<step>.<k>) in affected[0].

crank.description: Id of the revolute joint of the crankshaft (the joint the friction torque acts on).

cylinders.description: Cylinder pressure ids to read (add_cylinder_pressure). Omit = all on the crank.

id.description: Optional explicit loss record id.

model.description: Friction model and its constants; see the description.

aPa.description: chen_flynn: constant term, Pa (accessories, speed-independent losses).

bRatio.description: chen_flynn: gas-load term, dimensionless: Pa of FMEP per Pa of ABSOLUTE peak cylinder pressure.

cPaPerRpm.description: chen_flynn: linear speed term, Pa per rpm.

dPaPerRpm2.description: chen_flynn: quadratic speed term, Pa per rpm².

kind.description: "chen_flynn": FMEP = aPa + bRatio·p_max + cPaPerRpm·rpm + dPaPerRpm2·rpm² (fitted constants, stated accuracy 13 % mean / 35 % max [Chen-Flynn]). "fmep_table": FMEP (Pa) against rpm, linear between points, clamped outside (FPR_OUTSIDE_VALIDATED_RANGE). "component" (PNH / Sandoval-Heywood from bearings, valvetrain) is NOT supported: its equations are unchecked against a primary source, so it is refused rather than approximated.

points.description: fmep_table: [[rpm, FMEP in Pa], ...] with at least 2 points; 1 bar = 1e5 Pa.

source.description: REQUIRED: where the constants or table come from (paper, datasheet, test). No source, no model.

oilTempFactor.description: Multiplier on FMEP: 1 = hot (default), about 2.1 cold.

name: set_engine_losses

description: Set the display colour of one or more entities (2D or 3D). Pattern copies made by array_linear / array_polar / pattern_along_path follow their seed: a copy whose colour still equals its seed colour is recoloured too (a copy recoloured on its own is left alone). An assigned material (assign_material) still draws with the material colour in the viewport; the summary says so. Unknown ids are skipped and listed. Per-face colours of a mesh solid: set_face_color.

color.description: Hex colour "#rrggbb", e.g. "#c8553d"; any other format is rejected.

entityIds.description: Ids of the entities to recolour, e.g. ["box-1.1"].

name: set_entity_color

description: Move an entity to a different layer by updating its layerId. Graceful no-op if the entity or target layer does not exist. Rejected (graceful no-op) if the entity currently resides on a LOCKED layer — unlock the source layer first before reassigning its entities.

entityId.description: Id of the entity to reassign to a different layer.

layerId.description: Id of the destination layer. Must exist in the document.

name: set_entity_layer

description: Set an entity's display name and/or tags. Both fields are optional and independent — omitting a field leaves it unchanged. Pass name:"" to clear the name, or tags:[] to clear all tags. Enables AI/CLI plans to reference entities by meaning instead of generated ids, and allows `find_entities` to filter by name or tag.

id.description: Id of the entity to label.

name.description: New display name for the entity, e.g. "Left wall". Omit to leave the existing name unchanged; pass an empty string to clear it.

tags.description: Array of semantic tag strings to assign, e.g. ["structural","visible"]. Omit to leave existing tags unchanged. Pass [] to clear all tags.

name: set_entity_name

description: Set the run controls of an explicit_dynamics case (llull_explicit solver: central difference, lumped mass, hex8 one-point with Flanagan-Belytschko hourglass control, tet4): end time, history interval, time-step scale, optional minimum time step, mass scaling, gravity, hourglass and bulk viscosity coefficients and the mesh source. Times are {value, unit}; gravity {vector, unit} (e.g. [0, 0, -9806.65] mm/s^2). Unset coefficients take NAMED defaults (time-step scale 0.9, hourglass 0.1, bulk viscosity 0.06 / 1.5) reported in the summary. mesh: structured_hex {size} (document units, axis-aligned unrotated boxes only) or fea_mesh (the linear tet mesh of fea_mesh). Initial velocities and rigid walls are kept. Next: set_initial_velocity, add_rigid_wall, then the explicit_run transport.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

bulkViscosity.description: Bulk viscosity coefficients. Default linear 0.06, quadratic 1.5 (named).

source.description: Where the value comes from (company rule, reference); recorded with the value.
Where the value comes from (company rule, reference); recorded with the value.

unit.description: Time unit, e.g. 's', 'ms', 'us'.
Acceleration unit, e.g. 'mm/s^2', 'm/s^2'.

historyInterval.description: Sampling interval of the energy and rigid-wall histories, 0 < interval <= endTime.

unit.description: Time unit, e.g. 's', 'ms', 'us'.

hourglassCoefficient.description: Viscous hourglass coefficient of hex8 in [0, 0.5]. Default 0.1 (named).

source.description: Where the value comes from (company rule, reference); recorded with the value.

maxAddedMassRatio.description: selective only, REQUIRED there: largest added mass / model mass allowed (no default).

mode.description: none (default) or selective: raise the density of elements whose step is below the target.

targetTimeStep.description: selective only: the step every element must reach.

unit.description: Time unit, e.g. 's', 'ms', 'us'.

kind.description: structured_hex (llull grid on boxes) or fea_mesh (the case mesh artifact, tet4).

size.description: structured_hex only: target element edge, document length units, > 0.

minTimeStep.description: The run ends abnormally when the stable step falls below this.

unit.description: Time unit, e.g. 's', 'ms', 'us'.

timeStepScale.description: Multiplier of the stable time step, in (0, 1]. Default 0.9 (named).

source.description: Where the value comes from (company rule, reference); recorded with the value.

name: set_explicit_controls

description: Mesh a thin box part of an explicit_dynamics case as Belytschko-Tsay shells (llull_explicit, CPU path): the mid-surface across the two largest dimensions, shell thickness = the smallest dimension, one-point in-plane integration with `points` Gauss points through the thickness (default 2), elastic or Johnson-Cook plane-stress plasticity. Needs the structured_hex mesh source. shell: false meshes the part as hex8 again. Shells take part in rigid walls, not in contacts.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

entityId.description: A box part of the case whose smallest dimension is at most a quarter of the other two.

points.description: Gauss points through the thickness, 1 to 5. Default 2 (LS-DYNA NIP default).

shell.description: true: shells; false: back to hex8.

name: set_explicit_shell

description: Set the export-control marking (none, EAR99, EAR + eccn, ITAR) of a material record. Raising a marking is always allowed. Lowering it (for example ITAR → none) is a human act: it needs `confirmation`, a signature produced in the desktop app; an agent gets MAT_HUMAN_GATE. Export commands refuse documents that use EAR or ITAR records (MAT_EXPORT_CONTROLLED).

confirmation.description: Human signature object, required only to lower the marking.

category.description: USML category for ITAR, e.g. "XIII(g)"; optional.

eccn.description: Export Control Classification Number, e.g. "1C002"; required for regime EAR.

regime.description: Export-control regime: none, EAR99, EAR (needs eccn) or ITAR. EAR and ITAR content is gated on export.

material.description: Material id of a record (define_material_record or a library record).

name: set_export_marking

description: Colour single faces of a mesh solid (kind "mesh": results of booleans, fillets, shells and other kernel operations, imported bodies). Pick each face by a point on it (faceNear, document frame, like draft_faces facesNear). A face is the smooth surface patch around the point (bounded by its B-rep edges on exact-kernel results, by creases sharper than 30 degrees on other meshes). Omit color to reset the picked faces to the entity colour. Drawn in the viewport and written to glTF / GLB exports (one mesh node per face colour). Points farther than 1% of the solid size from it are skipped and listed.

color.description: Hex colour "#rrggbb". Omit to clear the colour of the picked faces.

faceNear.description: One point per face to colour.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] on the face, document frame.

id.description: Id of the mesh solid.

name: set_face_color

description: Set the named factors of a fatigue case: scatter {value >= 1, source} (NO default: ask the owner), Miner damageLimit (default 1), marginalBand, Marin modifiers (surface / size / reliability / environment / other: value > 0 multiplying the curve strength, each with a justification; REPLACES the list) and compressiveMean (no_benefit | formula). Fields you omit keep their value.

compressiveMean.description: Compressive mean-stress rule: no_benefit (default, conservative) or formula.

damageLimit.description: Miner damage limit D (> 0). Default 1 (Palmgren-Miner rule), reported as defaulted.

marginalBand.description: Margin band (>= 0): 0 <= margin < band is MARGINAL. No default.

modifiers.description: REPLACES the Marin modifier list (surface, size, reliability, ...). Each needs value > 0 and a justification.

justification.description: Mandatory reason / source of the factor.

name.description: Which Marin-type modifier this is.

value.description: Factor > 0 multiplying the curve strength (0.8 = 20 % weaker than the test specimen). Never defaulted.

scatter.description: Scatter factor SF on life. There is NO default: without it compute_fatigue refuses with FAT_SCATTER_FACTOR_UNSET.

source.description: Mandatory source of the factor (regulation, company rule, case input).

name: set_fatigue_factors

description: Set the frequency band of a frequency_response / random_response case (CalculiX *STEADY STATE DYNAMICS): fMinHz, fMaxHz in Hz, pointsPerInterval n (CalculiX default 20, >= 2) and bias (default 3, >= 1: points cluster at the eigenfrequencies; with m modes in the band CalculiX writes n m - m + n points). For a random case the band also bounds the response integral (intersected with the spectrum).

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

bias.description: Point clustering at the eigenfrequencies; default 3 (CalculiX), 1 = equally spaced.

pointsPerInterval.description: Data points per interval between fixed frequencies; default 20 (CalculiX).

name: set_frequency_sweep

description: Set the gravity vector of the physics simulation in m/s², world axes. Default [0, 0, -9.81] (Z up, Earth). [0, 0, 0] = weightless (isolates a mechanism from its own weight); [0, 0, -1.62] = Moon.

gravity.description: Gravity acceleration [x, y, z] in m/s².

name: set_gravity

description: Record the heat tracing of a pipe line (create_pipeline): tracer type (electric | steam | hot_water | thermal_fluid), the number of tracers along the pipe (1 to 6), the temperature to maintain (degC) and the extra tracer length per valve, flange and pipe support (allowances, metres per item: the loop that wraps the fitting). Data only: it does not change the route. piping_takeoff then lists the tracer length per traced line = tracers x (centreline length) + tracers x (valves x valveM + flanges x flangeM + supports x supportM), supports being the pipe supports on the line runs (add_pipe_support runId), and line_heat_loss gives the heat the tracing must replace at maintainTempC. Omitted fields keep their value; remove: true deletes the tracing. Returns the line id (affected[0]); data = { lineId, tracing }. Refusals: RTE_UNKNOWN_LINE, RTE_TRACING_INVALID (the first setting needs type and tracers). Next: piping_takeoff, line_heat_loss.

allowances.description: Extra tracer length per fitting, metres per item. Absent = none counted (the takeoff names this).

supportM.description: Extra tracer per pipe support, metres.

maintainTempC.description: Temperature the line content is kept at, degC.

remove.description: true deletes the tracing of the line.

tracers.description: Number of tracers run along the pipe, 1 to 6.

type.description: Tracer type: electric (trace cable), steam, hot_water or thermal_fluid (glycol / oil).

name: set_heat_tracing

description: Set the uniform initial temperature of a heat_steady / heat_transient analysis (value + unit degC | K | degF). MANDATORY for a transient (never defaulted); for a steady case it is only the start of the nonlinear iteration (useful with radiation). Written as *INITIAL CONDITIONS on every node.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

unit.description: Temperature unit: 'degC', 'K' or 'degF'.

name: set_initial_temperature

description: Give every node of a part of an explicit_dynamics case an initial velocity {vector, unit} (e.g. [0, 0, -10000] mm/s). One velocity per part; calling again replaces it and a zero vector removes it. The part must be in the case (set_part_idealization).

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

entityId.description: Id of a part of the case.

unit.description: Velocity unit, e.g. 'mm/s', 'm/s'.

name: set_initial_velocity

description: Make this document a managed configuration item: part number, name, item type and revision scheme. Creates revision 1 (asme-alpha: A) in state in_work, iteration 1. Calling it again before review renames / re-schemes the item. After submit_for_review or a release the identity is frozen (PLM_IDENTITY_FROZEN). Passing `policy` is a human act. Next: edit the model, then submit_for_review.

at.description: When the act happened: ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:30:00Z. The host (UI / llull CLI) fills it; commands never read a clock.

by.description: User id doing the act (the host fills it from the authenticated user; an agent cannot override it where the server has named users).

confirmation.description: HUMAN SIGNATURE, required: { alg: "Ed25519", keyId, publicKey, signature, nonce } made by a human with a TRUSTED signing key over this exact act (get the bytes with plm_act_payload, sign them in the desktop app or `llull exec ... --confirm-key KEYID`). An agent has no trusted key: it prepares the act and hands over (PLM_HUMAN_GATE).

customLabels.description: Ordered revision labels of a 'custom:<name>' scheme, e.g. ['X1','X2'].

name.description: Item name, e.g. "Bracket, hinge fitting".

partNumber.description: Part number: A-Z, 0-9, . _ - / (max 64 characters, starts with a letter or digit), e.g. LL-1001.

policy.description: Policy overrides (human-only: an agent caller is refused).

humanSignatureRequired.description: Release needs a recorded human Ed25519 approval signature (needs a signing host). Default true.

requireChangeOrder.description: Revising and releasing a later revision needs an open ECO listing the item. Default true.

requireIndependentChecker.description: The checker approval must come from a different user than the author. Default true.

requireMarking.description: Submit for review is refused while the export marking regime is 'undetermined'. Default false.

requiredApprovalRoles.description: Roles that must approve before release. Default ['design-authority','checker'].

revisionScheme.description: Revision label scheme: 'asme-alpha' (default: A..Y without I O Q S X Z, then AA..), 'numeric-2' (01, 02, ...) or 'custom:<name>' (with customLabels).

name: set_item_identity

description: Record the managed item's export-control marking: regime (none, undetermined, ITAR, EAR, EU-dual-use, national, other), the user's own classification text (e.g. ECCN or USML category) and the notice to print. HUMAN GATE. llull never classifies: the export-control officer decides. A controlled regime needs a statement. With policy.requireMarking, submit_for_review is refused while the regime is undetermined. Not the material-record marking (set_export_marking). An agent caller gets PLM_HUMAN_GATE.

at.description: When the act happened: ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:30:00Z. The host (UI / llull CLI) fills it; commands never read a clock.

classification.description: The decided classification text, e.g. ECCN 9A610 or USML VIII(h). Free text, never validated.

confirmation.description: HUMAN SIGNATURE, required: { alg: "Ed25519", keyId, publicKey, signature, nonce } made by a human with a TRUSTED signing key over this exact act (get the bytes with plm_act_payload, sign them in the desktop app or `llull exec ... --confirm-key KEYID`). An agent has no trusted key: it prepares the act and hands over (PLM_HUMAN_GATE).

decidedBy.description: Ignored: the decision is recorded under the signer of the confirmation (the trusted key record), never a name given here.

regime.description: Export-control regime decided by the officer.

statement.description: Notice printed on every sheet and in the release manifest. Required for a controlled regime.

name: set_item_marking

description: Give a material of an explicit_dynamics case Johnson-Cook failure constants: eps_f = [D1 + D2 exp(D3 s)][1 + D4 ln(rate/rate0)][1 + D5 T*], s = mean stress / von Mises (positive in tension, the 1985 convention: D3 is usually negative), rate0 = the Johnson-Cook reference rate of the material. Damage D = sum(d eps_p / eps_f); an element whose damage reaches 1 is eroded (no stress, counted in failedElements). Needs the Johnson-Cook strength law on the material (PHY-02 set). No default: give the five values and where they come from (report, table, page). Omit D to remove the constants.

D.description: [D1, D2, D3, D4, D5]; omit to remove.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

material.description: Document material id (create_material name) used by a part of the case.

source.description: REQUIRED with D: where the constants come from, e.g. "DOT/FAA/AR-03/57 table 5, p. 12".

name: set_johnson_cook_failure

description: Set the current value of a kinematic joint. For revolute joints, "value" is the rotation angle in radians. For prismatic joints, "value" is the displacement in document units. Multi-DOF joints (cylindrical, pin_slot, planar, ball) take "dof" = index of the coordinate (0-based, order: cylindrical/pin_slot [angle, slide]; planar [u, v, angle]; ball [rx, ry, rz]). rigid and cam joints have no settable value (a cam follows its camJoint). The value is clamped into the joint limit when one is set. "value" may be a plain number or a parameter expression string (e.g. "=spoke_angle * 2" or "gap / 3"). Expression strings are stored as-is and evaluated when evaluate_motion is called. Call evaluate_motion (query; apply=true mutates the doc) to apply the new value to instance transforms.

dof.description: Index of the coordinate to set on a multi-DOF joint (0-based). Default 0.

id.description: Id of the joint to update. Must exist in doc.joints.

value.description: New joint value. For revolute: angle in radians. For prismatic: displacement in document units. May be a plain number ("1.5708") or a parameter expression string ("spoke_angle * 2"). Expression strings reference named parameters in doc.parameters.

name: set_joint_value

description: Configure the laminate design rules of a part (read by check_laminate_rules and check_layup). Defaults are the commonly published guidelines, not CMH-17 clauses: symmetric, balanced, at least 10% of plies in each of the 0 / +-45 / 90 families (minFraction 0.1), at most 4 consecutive plies of one angle (maxConsecutive), outer plies +-45 (outerPlusMinus45). maxAngleChange (degrees) adds the adjacent-ply disorientation rule. `disable` lists rules switched off with a mandatory justification: rule is one of "R1" (symmetry), "R2" (balance), "R3" (min fraction), "R4" (consecutive), "R5" (outer +-45), "DISORIENTATION". For release, a disabled rule is only accepted after a human approval; check_layup purpose "release" still reports it.

disable.description: Rules to switch off, each with a justification.

justification.description: Why the rule is switched off.

maxAngleChange.description: Maximum angle change between adjacent plies, degrees (0..90); omitted = rule off.

maxConsecutive.description: Maximum consecutive plies of one angle, integer >= 1 (R4); default 4.

minFraction.description: Minimum fraction (0..1, not percent) of plies per 0 / +-45 / 90 family (R3); default 0.1.

symmetric.description: Require a symmetric stack (R1); default true.

name: set_laminate_rules

description: Retire a revision: released or superseded -> obsolete, in_work -> cancelled (an in_review revision needs reject_review first). A reason is mandatory; obsoleting a released revision also needs an open change order (policy.requireChangeOrder). The content hash and snapshot stay; obsolete and cancelled revisions no longer resolve by effectivity. Not reversible (terminal states). Obsoleting is a human act (`confirmation`).

at.description: When the act happened: ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:30:00Z. The host (UI / llull CLI) fills it; commands never read a clock.

by.description: User id doing the act (the host fills it from the authenticated user; an agent cannot override it where the server has named users).

confirmation.description: HUMAN SIGNATURE, required: { alg: "Ed25519", keyId, publicKey, signature, nonce } made by a human with a TRUSTED signing key over this exact act (get the bytes with plm_act_payload, sign them in the desktop app or `llull exec ... --confirm-key KEYID`). An agent has no trusted key: it prepares the act and hands over (PLM_HUMAN_GATE).

name: set_lifecycle_state

description: Record the marginal band of an analysis: a row with 0 <= MS < band reads MARGINAL in compute_margins and check_analysis stops warning FEA_MARGINAL_BAND_UNSET. There is NO default: the value comes from the owner or the company rule (never invent one). Omit `marginalBand` to clear it. Pass the same value as marginalBand to compute_margins to see the MARGINAL rows.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

marginalBand.description: Band in margin-of-safety units, a finite number >= 0 (e.g. 0.1). Omit to clear the stored band.

name: set_margin_band

description: Set the material axes of a part of a thermo_static or coupled_temperature_displacement analysis whose material has an orthotropic CTE (cte / thermalStrain property models with direction 1, 2, 3). axis1 is material direction 1 and axis2 any vector in the 1-2 plane, both in the document frame; direction 3 is axis1 x axis2. Without an orientation the directions 1 / 2 / 3 are the document X / Y / Z axes, which is refused for a rotated part (TMC_ORIENTATION_REQUIRED). Omit axis1 and axis2 to remove the orientation of the part. Written as *ORIENTATION and the ORIENTATION= parameter of the part section.

analysisId.description: Id of a thermo_static or coupled_temperature_displacement analysis.

axis1.description: Material direction 1 as [x, y, z] in the document frame (any non-zero length).

axis2.description: Any [x, y, z] vector in the material 1-2 plane, not parallel to axis1.

entityId.description: Id of a part of the analysis (set_part_idealization).

name: set_material_orientation

description: Add a sourced property value to a material: density, E, Ec, G, nu, Ftu, Fty, Fcy, Fsu, Fbru, Fbry, elongation, cte, k, cp. Give value + unit (any unit of the right dimension: g/cm^3, lb/in^3, ksi, MPa, Msi, GPa), the basis (A, B, S, typical, supplier_unstated, company, unspecified; REQUIRED for strengths) and the source (citation + locator, REQUIRED). Optional keys: direction (L, LT, ST, isotropic …), thickness range, e/D for bearing, and a temperature table (absolute values or percent of the room-temperature value). Several values may coexist (two supplier densities); mark at most one preferred per key. Values of typical / supplier_unstated / unspecified basis are flagged unverified downstream. Stored as a PHY-01 property model, so evaluate_property and get_material_allowable read it. Records imported from a library are read-only. Next: get_material_allowable, mass_properties, check_materials.

basis.description: A | B | S | typical | supplier_unstated | company | unspecified. Required for strengths; default unspecified (unverified).

direction.description: Grain / material direction: L, LT, ST, 1, 2, 3, normal, warp, fill, or isotropic (same as omitted).

edOverD.description: Bearing edge-distance ratio e/D (1.5 or 2.0) of an Fbru / Fbry value.

id.description: Id of the value on the material (default derived from the key, e.g. "Ftu.L.A.t0p02-0p128").

material.description: Material id (the name given to create_material or the id of define_material_record).

preferred.description: Mark as THE value for its key (at most one preferred per property, direction, basis, thickness, e/D).

property.description: Property: density, E, Ec, G, nu, Ftu, Fty, Fcy, Fsu, Fbru, Fbry, elongation, cte, k, cp.

replace.description: Replace an existing value with the same id (default false: PROP_MODEL_EXISTS).

source.description: Provenance of the value. REQUIRED.

citation.description: Bibliographic citation of the value, e.g. "MIL-HDBK-5J". Required; blank is MAT_PROVENANCE_MISSING.

temperature.description: Temperature dependence; the room-temperature value is a separate call without temperature.

exposureHours.description: Exposure time at temperature in hours (MIL-HDBK-5 exposure curves); part of the value key.

mode.description: absolute: points are [temperature, value] in `unit`; percentOfRT: points are [temperature, percent of the room-temperature value].

points.description: [[temperature, value or percent], …], at least 2, temperatures strictly increasing. Evaluation is linear and never extrapolates.

rtModelId.description: percentOfRT only: id of the room-temperature model the percentages scale. Default: the only constant model with the same property, basis, direction, thickness and e/D.

temperatureUnit.description: Unit of the temperature column of points.

thickness.description: Product thickness range of the value (allowables are tabulated per thickness range).

max.description: Largest product thickness the value applies to.

min.description: Smallest product thickness the value applies to.

unit.description: Length unit, e.g. 'in' or 'mm'.
Unit of the value, e.g. 'g/cm^3', 'lb/in^3', 'ksi', 'MPa', 'GPa', '1' (dimensionless), '%'.

value.description: The value in `unit` (room temperature). Omit when a temperature table is given.

name: set_material_property

description: Set the tetrahedral mesh controls of an analysis (Netgen): element order (1 = linear C3D4, 2 = quadratic C3D10, default 2; use 2 for stress), globalSize (target element edge length, document units, > 0), optional minSize and refinements (local size at points near faces / edges / vertices of a part, size <= globalSize). Only the given fields change. Lengths are in document units. Changing the mesh makes a recorded mesh and results stale (describe_analysis shows the state); the host re-runs fea_mesh.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

bonding.description: How touching parts of a multi-part analysis are meshed. "separate" (default): one independent volume per part, no shared nodes (needed for contact). "conformal": all parts are fragmented into one shape meshed at once so touching parts share their interface nodes (bonded / perfectly glued parts; each part keeps its own element set and material). Conformal needs exact STEP geometry (OCC kernel) and parts that only touch (do not overlap: subtract one from the other first); otherwise fea_mesh is refused.

elementFamily.description: Element shape of shell / plane-stress parts: shell_tri (triangles, S3 / S6, CPS3 / CPS6) or shell_quad (all quadrilaterals by subdivision, S4 / S8, CPS4 / CPS8; needed for composite shells: order 2). Solid parts are always tetrahedra; "tet" (default) meshes 2D parts with triangles.

globalSize.description: Target element edge length in document units, > 0.

minSize.description: Smallest allowed element size in document units, > 0 and <= globalSize.

refinements.description: Replaces the whole refinement list (empty array clears it).

size.description: Element size at the target, document units, <= globalSize.

target.description: Faces / edges / points to refine (points near them, document units).

edgesNear.description: Points identifying edges: each resolves to the nearest edge.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended edge.

entityId.description: Id of the analysed 3D entity (it must be a part of the analysis: set_part_idealization).

facesNear.description: Points identifying faces: each resolves to the NEAREST face of the entity at meshing time.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended face.

intersectPlane.description: Optional: restrict the target to the curve where the faces meet this plane.

normal.description: Plane normal (need not be unit length).

pointsNear.description: Points identifying vertices / locations: each resolves to the nearest vertex or node.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended vertex or location.

name: set_mesh_controls

description: Set the document modelling tolerances used by exact (B-rep) work. linear (mm, range 1e-7 to 1e-2, default 1e-4) is the heal / sew / STEP import precision; angular (rad, range 1e-12 to 1e-3, default 1e-9); maxImportTolerance (mm, range 1e-7 to 1, default 0.01, not below linear) is the threshold above which import_step_exact warns KRN_IMPORT_TOLERANCE_HIGH. Pass only the values to change. Out-of-range values are refused with KRN_TOLERANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE. Read the current values with kernel_info.

angular.description: Angular modelling tolerance in radians; 1e-12 to 1e-3. Default 1e-9.

linear.description: Linear modelling tolerance in millimetres (NOT document units); 1e-7 to 1e-2. Default 1e-4.

maxImportTolerance.description: Warn threshold in millimetres for sub-shape tolerances after STEP import / heal; 1e-7 to 1, at least linear. Default 0.01.

name: set_modeling_tolerance

description: Set the global controls of a nonlinear_static analysis (CalculiX): nlgeom (REQUIRED, no default: true = large displacement / *STEP NLGEOM, false = small displacement with material nonlinearity only), the convergence criteria and which increments are stored. convergence: name "ccx_default" (no *CONTROLS card, CalculiX defaults) or "custom" with field (the *CONTROLS FIELD tolerances R_n, C_n, ...) and/or timeIncrementation (I_0 ... I_T). outputIncrements: "all" (every increment, a curve point per increment; default), "last_per_step" or { every: n }. Creates the nonlinear settings of the case on first use and keeps existing steps, probes and constitutive sets on later calls. Next: set_part_constitutive_set, add_analysis_step, add_curve_probe, then the host runs fea_mesh and fea_solve.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

field.description: custom only: *CONTROLS PARAMETERS=FIELD tolerances, key -> number > 0; unlisted keys keep the CalculiX default. Keys: Rn (largest residual force relative to the average force, default 0.005), Cn (largest correction relative to the largest incremental solution, 0.02), q0 and qu (force thresholds below which a residual is zero, automatic), Rp (residual tolerance of the 2nd check, 0.02), eps (correction tolerance of the 2nd check, 1e-5), Ceps (largest correction at a node with a low residual, 0.001), Rl (line-search residual tolerance, 1e-8).

name.description: ccx_default = CalculiX defaults (no *CONTROLS); custom = the values below.

timeIncrementation.description: custom only: *CONTROLS PARAMETERS=TIME INCREMENTATION values, key -> integer > 0; unlisted keys keep the CalculiX default. Keys: I0 (iterations before a stagnating residual may be accepted, 4), IR (iterations before the convergence rate is checked, 8), IP (iterations before the looser tolerance applies, 9), IC (iterations after which divergence is assumed, 16), IL (iterations beyond which the next increment shrinks, 10), IG (iterations below which it grows, 4), IS (iterations of the cutback test, 12), IA (maximum cutbacks of an increment, 5), IJ (iterations between Jacobian updates, 6), IT (maximum iterations per increment, 200).

nlgeom.description: true = geometric nonlinearity (large displacements, *STEP NLGEOM); false = small displacements (refused when a part uses a hyperelastic set: CalculiX forces NLGEOM for those). Always state it.

outputIncrements.description: Which increments are stored for fields and curve probes: "all" (default), "last_per_step" or { every: n }.

name: set_nonlinear_controls

description: Create or update a named numeric parameter in the document. The expression may be a numeric literal (e.g. "10") or reference other parameters by name using +, -, *, / and parentheses (e.g. "width * 2 + 5"). After setting the parameter, all dependent parameters are re-evaluated in topological order. An invalid expression is stored with an error message rather than rejecting the call. Parameter names must be non-empty strings containing only letters, digits, and underscores.

expression.description: Numeric expression defining the parameter value. May be a plain number ("10", "3.14") or a formula referencing other parameter names ("width * 2", "base_height + offset", "(a + b) / 2"). Supports +, -, *, /, parentheses, unary minus, and decimal numbers.

name.description: Parameter name used as its identifier and in expressions that reference it. Must be non-empty and contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), digits, and underscores. Example: "width", "wall_thickness", "radius2".

name: set_parameter

description: Choose the constitutive set (elastic + plastic / hyperelastic behaviour, from define_constitutive_set on the part material) that a part uses in a nonlinear_static analysis. The deck then carries that set's CalculiX cards (*ELASTIC, *PLASTIC, ...) exactly as export_material_cards writes them; no stress-strain values are stored in the analysis. Omit constitutiveSetId to use the material's default set (the summary names it). Sets with creep, viscoelastic or rate laws are refused for a static step. Parts that share a material must use the same set. Needs the part (set_part_idealization) and its assigned material.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

constitutiveSetId.description: Id of a ConstitutiveSet of the part's material record (define_constitutive_set). Default: the material's default set.

entityId.description: Id of a part of the analysis (set_part_idealization).

name: set_part_constitutive_set

description: Mark 3D entities or instances as attached to the world (grounded = true) or release them (false). check_assembly treats a part that is grounded, belongs to a fixed rigid body or is the child of a joint whose parent is the ground as an anchor: every part must connect to an anchor through joints, rigid bodies, fasteners or contact, else FPR_PART_FLOATING. Use it for frames, stands and bolted-down parts that have no dynamics body. Unknown or 2D ids and a request that changes nothing are no-ops. Next: check_assembly.

grounded.description: true = attach to the world, false = release.

ids.description: Entity or instance ids to mark.

name: set_part_grounded

description: Add a 3D solid to an analysis as a meshed part. idealization "solid" (default): 3D tetrahedra. "shell": shell elements on the midsurface (sheet-metal parts and box plates need no kernel; other solids are face-paired on the exact OCC kernel: planar walls <= maxThickness), thickness = the wall thickness found (or give it), offset mid | top | bottom, optional compositePartId (06 CMP part: its laminateSectionId section, or its whole-face plies: a composite shell section). "plane_stress": 2D elements on the face near sourceFacesNear, which must lie in z = 0, with thickness. Shell and plane_stress are for static, modal and buckling cases. Constraints and loads still name points on the SOLID: a point on a side face of a plate targets the shell edge there. Preview the midsurface with extract_midsurface. Lengths in document units. The part needs a material (assign_material) before solving, except a composite shell.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

angularTolDeg.description: Shell: largest angle between two paired faces, degrees (default 1).

compositePartId.description: Shell: id of the 06 CMP composite part laid up on this entity (composite section).

entityId.description: Id of the 3D solid entity to analyse (box, cylinder, extrusion, boolean result, sheet-metal part, ...).

laminateSectionId.description: Shell + compositePartId: id of a laminate section of that part (create_laminate_sections, e.g. one per zone); default: its whole-face plies.

maxThickness.description: Shell: thickest wall that pairs into a midsurface (default 1.01 x thickness; needed for face pairing without thickness).

midsurfaceMinCoverage.description: Shell: paired-area fraction the midsurface needs (default 0.98). Lowering it meshes a partial midsurface: justify it.

offset.description: Shell: meshed reference surface, the midsurface (default) or the top / bottom wall surface.

sourceFacesNear.description: plane_stress: points picking the face(s) that form the 2D domain.

items.description: Point on (or near) a planar face of the solid in z = 0, document units.

thickness.description: Shell: section thickness (default: the wall thickness of the midsurface, or the laminate). plane_stress: required.

name: set_part_idealization

description: Set the project settings of the piping plugin. lineNumberTemplate: how create_pipeline / update_pipeline build line numbers, with placeholders {dn}, {service}, {sequence}, {spec}, {insulationCode}, {insulationThickness}, literal text, and optional groups [...] that disappear when a field inside is empty (default {dn}-{service}-{sequence}-{spec}[-{insulationCode}{insulationThickness}]: DN 80, service HO, sequence 4001, spec CS150, insulation H 50 mm gives 80-HO-4001-CS150-H50). The template needs {sequence} (it keeps numbers unique) and no placeholder twice. null restores the default. Lines whose number followed the old template are renumbered to the new one; explicit line numbers are kept and listed in data.keptExplicit. Returns data = { template { value, defaulted }, renumbered [{ lineId, from, to }], keptExplicit }. Refusals: RTE_TEMPLATE_INVALID (detail says why), RTE_DUPLICATE_LINE_NUMBER (two lines would get the same number; nothing changes). Next: create_pipeline, update_pipeline.

lineNumberTemplate.description: New line-number template, e.g. "{service}-{sequence}-{dn}-{spec}[-{insulationCode}]"; null restores the default; omit to keep.

name: set_piping_settings

description: Set the ply drop-off rules of a part, used by generate_plies_from_zones and check_layup. rampRatio: ramp length per dropped thickness (default 20, i.e. 1:20, a user rule not a mandate); minStagger with staggerUnit "dropped_thickness" (multiples of the ply thickness, default 3) or "length" (document length units); dropOrder "inner_first" (default: plies nearest the mid-plane end first, outer plies run longest) or "outer_first"; coverPlies: number of continuous plies kept on each surface (default 1).

coverPlies.description: Continuous plies kept on each outer surface, integer >= 0; default 1.

dropOrder.description: Which plies end first at a step; default "inner_first".

minStagger.description: Minimum stagger between drops; unit per staggerUnit; >= 0; default 3.

name: set_ply_drop_rules

description: Declare the governing GD&T standard of the document: ASME_Y14.5_2018 or ISO_GPS (ISO 1101 family), which decides symbol set and rule table. Optionally store a general tolerance / title-block note as plain text (e.g. "UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: LINEAR +-0.1"); llull never computes values from a general-tolerance table. Creates the PMI model on first use; existing items are kept. Next: add_datum_feature, add_size_dimension, add_geometric_tolerance.

generalToleranceNote.description: General tolerance note text, stored and printed as given (document units are the unit of any value in it). Omit to keep the stored note.

name: set_pmi_standard

description: Set project metadata used by plan-sheet title blocks and IFC export: project name, client, site address, author, drawing number, revision, date. Omitted fields are kept.

date.description: Issue date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-10-01" (other formats are not used for the IFC header).

name.description: Project name.

name: set_project_info

description: Set the stress-free (reference) temperature of a thermo_static or coupled_temperature_displacement analysis: the temperature at which the parts carry no thermal strain. Thermal strain is the secant CTE times (T - reference), and the reference is also the initial temperature of the solve. There is no default; it must be stated with a unit (degC, K, degF). Changing it makes recorded mesh-independent results stale.

analysisId.description: Id of a thermo_static or coupled_temperature_displacement analysis.

unit.description: Temperature unit: degC, K or degF.

name: set_reference_temperature

description: Choose what the result view of an analysis shows: field (von_mises, u_mag, u_x, u_y, u_z, s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, or mode for a modal / buckling case), the load case or the mode number, and the deformation scale (1 = true scale, 0 = undeformed, larger exaggerates; render_fea_results also takes its own deformationScale). It only records the choice on the case (the desktop result panel reads it); it solves nothing and does not make results stale. To read numbers use fea_result_field, to see a picture use render_fea_results.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

deformationScale.description: Deformed-shape scale factor, a finite number >= 0 (default 1; 0 = undeformed).

field.description: Field to show: von_mises | u_mag | u_x | u_y | u_z | s_xx | s_yy | s_zz | mode (modal / buckling mode shape).

loadCase.description: Load case to show (1-40 letters, digits or underscores). Omit for the first.

mode.description: field mode only: mode number, 1-based (default 1).

name: set_result_view

description: Record a reviewer status and comment on one finding of check_prototype (pass the findingKey of the item and the inputsHash of its check, data.checks[].inputsHash; the stand-alone checks run with other parameters, so their hashes differ and would read stale): status "relevant" (needs work), "irrelevant" (does not apply, say why), "accepted" (known and accepted as is) or "not_reviewed". Stored in the document (doc.prototype.dispositions) with the inputsHash of the check it was made on: when that check is re-run on changed inputs the disposition is kept but flagged stale for re-review. An "accepted" disposition NEVER turns a fail into a pass: the item reads "fail (accepted)" and check_prototype stays blocked while a fail remains. "not_reviewed" with an empty comment clears the disposition. Next: check_prototype.

comment.description: Reviewer comment (why it is irrelevant / accepted, what to do). Default empty.

confirmation.description: HUMAN signature, required for status "accepted": { alg: "Ed25519", keyId, publicKey, signature, nonce } produced with a trusted signing key over this act (findingKey, inputsHash, comment). An agent has none.

findingKey.description: The item findingKey from the check result, "<check>:<code>:<sorted ids>", e.g. "assembly:FPR_PAIR_HARD:box-1.1,box-2.1".

inputsHash.description: The inputsHash of the check_prototype check the finding came from (data.checks[].inputsHash); a later different hash marks it stale.

name: set_review_disposition

description: Change the revision label scheme of the managed item for FUTURE revisions (asme-alpha, numeric-2 or custom:<name> with customLabels). Existing revision labels never change.

customLabels.description: Ordered labels for a 'custom:<name>' scheme: the label of revision n is customLabels[n-1].

name: set_revision_scheme

description: Set the symmetric road template of an alignment: carriageway `laneWidth` and `shoulderWidth` each side of the centreline (document units), `crossfall` (ratio falling away from the centreline, 0.025 = 2.5 %), and the `cutSlope` / `fillSlope` batters (horizontal per 1 vertical). Defaults: 3.5 m lane, 1.0 m shoulder, 0.025, 1.5, 2.0 - or the current template values. With a profile the corridor is drawn; with a surface too, batters run to daylight.

cutSlope.description: Cut batter H per 1 V (> 0). Default 1.5.

fillSlope.description: Fill batter H per 1 V (> 0). Default 2.0.

laneWidth.description: Carriageway width each side (> 0). Default 3.5 m.

shoulderWidth.description: Shoulder width each side (>= 0). Default 1.0 m.

name: set_road_section

description: Create a named crop box (document units and frame) on some clouds (default: all). keep "inside" shows only the points inside and can be used as a query region ({kind:"crop",cropId}); "outside" hides them. Remove it with clear_scan_crop.

cloudIds.description: Clouds it applies to; default every cloud.

name.description: Crop name, e.g. "tie-in area".

name: set_scan_crop

description: Change which entities are selected (the selection that selection-based tools and the viewport highlight use). ids: entity ids; ids that do not exist are ignored. mode: "replace" (default) makes ids the whole selection (an empty list clears it), "add" appends them, "remove" removes them, "toggle" flips each one. Session command: not part of the feature history and not undoable.

ids.description: Entity ids to select / deselect. Unknown ids are ignored. Empty with mode "replace" clears the selection.

mode.description: replace (default): ids become the selection; add: append; remove: subtract; toggle: flip each id.

name: set_selection

description: Give a sheet-metal part its material and, optionally, its layer. The folded solid of a part is derived and read-only, so assign_material is refused on it; this command stores the material on the part itself, so mass_properties, the bill of materials and the export gate see it, and it survives every later edit of the part and save / load. The material must exist (create_material, define_material_record or an imported library record: use its name). Converted parts (convert_to_sheet_metal) describe an ordinary solid: use assign_material on it. Refusals: FTR_PART_NOT_FOUND, FTR_PARAM_INVALID. Next: mass_properties, check_sheet_metal.

id.description: Sheet-metal part id (returned by add_sheet_metal_base).

layerId.description: Optional id of an existing layer to put the folded solid on. Omit to leave the layer as it is.

materialName.description: Name of an existing material in the document (case-sensitive), e.g. "al2024".

name: set_sheet_metal_material

description: Calibrate the local site coordinates to the projected grid with a 2D similarity (Helmert): grid = gridOrigin + scaleFactor * R(rotationDeg) * (local - localOrigin), R counter-clockwise. Coordinates are in document units; elevations are unchanged. Used by transform_coordinates, import_survey_points (coordinates "grid") and the LandXML / DXF / sheet exports.

gridOrigin.description: [easting, northing] of the same control point in grid coordinates.

localOrigin.description: [x, y] of a control point in local (document) coordinates.

rotationDeg.description: Counter-clockwise rotation of local axes into grid axes, degrees. Default 0.

scaleFactor.description: Combined scale factor k = grid distance / local distance, > 0. Default 1.

name: set_site_calibration

description: Toggle the suppressed flag of a feature history step by its stepId. A suppressed step is skipped during replay, effectively hiding its contribution without deleting it. The document is regenerated after the flag is changed.

stepId.description: Id of the FeatureStep to suppress or un-suppress (from doc.featureHistory[*].id).

suppressed.description: true to suppress (skip during replay), false to restore.

name: set_step_suppressed

description: Set the superelevation (banking) of an alignment: `maxRate` is the full rate on circular curves as a ratio (0.07 = 7 %, at most 0.15; 0 removes the design). The section rotates about the centreline with the outer side raised: normal crown on tangents, the adverse side runs out to flat then up to the full rate at a constant rotation rate, reaching it at the SC / CS of a spiral (or 30 % of the runoff inside a curve without spiral). `runoffLength` (document units, > 0) is the ramp length from flat to full rate at each curve end; default the spiral length, or the length that keeps the lane-edge relative gradient at 0.5 % (maxRate x laneWidth / 0.005). A rate below the crossfall is raised to the crossfall. Corridor, cross sections, volumes and alignment_report follow.

maxRate.description: Full superelevation rate on curves, ratio 0..0.15 (0.07 = 7 %). 0 removes it.

runoffLength.description: Runoff length per curve end, document units (> 0). Default: spiral length or 0.5 % gradient.

name: set_superelevation

description: Set the temperature field a thermo_static analysis is loaded with (replaces the previous one). source.kind: uniform (one value for all nodes), expression (a function of node coordinates x, y, z evaluated at every mesh node at deck time), thermal_result (nodal temperatures of a SOLVED heat_steady / heat_transient analysis at an output time or "last", on the same mesh or, with mapping "interpolate", on a different mesh by shape-function interpolation; a re-solved or edited thermal analysis makes this analysis stale) or table (x, y, z, T rows in the artifact store, written by the fea_import_field tool). Optional cteBasis states, per material id, whether its cte property model is secant (about a reference temperature) or instantaneous; without it a cte model of unstated basis is refused at solve time (a thermalStrain model needs none). Give source, cteBasis or both. A coupled_temperature_displacement analysis solves its own field: it takes cteBasis only (no source). Next: check_thermo_mechanical.

analysisId.description: Id of a thermo_static (or, for cteBasis only, a coupled_temperature_displacement) analysis.

kind.description: The cte values are secant coefficients about a reference temperature.

referenceTemperature.description: Reference temperature the secant coefficients are relative to.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

kind.description: The cte values are instantaneous (tangent) coefficients.

cteBasis.description: Per material id: the stated basis of its cte property model. Entries replace earlier entries of the same material.

kind.description: The same temperature at every node.

value.description: Temperature { value, unit } with unit degC, K or degF. There is no default.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

coordinatesUnit.description: Unit x, y, z are expressed in when the expression is evaluated.

expression.description: Arithmetic expression of x, y, z (+ - * /, pi, sqrt, hypot, pow, sin, exp, ...; no ^). Example: "20 + 0.5 * z".

kind.description: Temperature computed at each mesh node from an expression in x, y, z.

analysisId.description: Id of the solved heat_* analysis that provides the temperatures.

kind.description: Nodal temperatures of a solved heat_steady / heat_transient analysis (same mesh, or mapping interpolate).

mapping.description: same_mesh (default): the thermal case must be meshed identically (TMC_MESH_MISMATCH otherwise). interpolate: the thermal nodal temperatures are interpolated with the shape functions of the containing thermal element at every node of this analysis mesh (a node outside every thermal element takes the value at the nearest point of the nearest element and is counted).

time.description: Output time in seconds (an output time of the thermal results) or "last".

coordinatesUnit.description: Unit of the x, y, z columns, e.g. "mm".

csvSha256.description: sha256 of the table artifact in the artifact store (written by fea_import_field).

kind.description: Temperatures from a table of x, y, z, T rows stored in the artifact store, matched to mesh nodes.

rows.description: Number of rows of the table (checked against the artifact).

temperatureUnit.description: Unit of the T column: degC, K or degF.

source.description: Where the nodal temperatures come from; omit to leave the field unchanged (cteBasis only).

name: set_temperature_field

description: Override the Stefan-Boltzmann constant of a heat_* analysis (W/(m^2*K^4)) with a sourced value, e.g. to reproduce a published benchmark that rounds sigma (5.67e-8). Without stefanBoltzmann the override is removed and the exact SI value 5.670374419e-8 applies. The override is recorded with defaulted: false and its source in analysis_report.physicalConstants and enters the input hash.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

stefanBoltzmann.description: The override. Omit to restore the SI exact default.

source.description: Citation of the value (a benchmark statement, a standard, a company rule); required.

value.description: Stefan-Boltzmann constant in W/(m^2*K^4), finite and > 0.

name: set_thermal_physical_constants

description: Set the time stepping of a heat_transient analysis (a heat_steady case needs none) or make a coupled_temperature_displacement analysis transient (giving endTimeS turns its steady-state step into a transient one; the case needs set_initial_temperature or a field for a start state, cp and density on the materials, and the thermal BC amplitudes drive it): endTimeS, initialIncrementS, minIncrementS, maxIncrementS, fixedIncrements (constant increments), maxTemperatureChangePerIncrement (DELTMX, K) and the result times (outputTimesS or outputEveryS; with fixedIncrements only outputEveryS, a multiple of the increment). Times are in seconds. Only the given fields change. A transient also needs set_initial_temperature and cp + density on the materials.

analysisId.description: Id of the analysis (affected[0] of create_analysis, e.g. an-1.1).

endTimeS.description: Transient only: end time of the step, seconds, > 0 (required once for a transient).

fixedIncrements.description: true: constant increments (*HEAT TRANSFER, DIRECT). Excludes outputTimesS and maxTemperatureChangePerIncrement.

initialIncrementS.description: First (or, with fixedIncrements, every) time increment, seconds. Default endTimeS/100 (named in the deck).

maxTemperatureChangePerIncrement.description: Largest temperature change per increment as { value, unit: "K" } (DELTMX); the solver shortens increments to respect it.

unit.description: Unit text of the 08 grammar, e.g. 'degC', 'K', 'W/(m^2*K)', 'W'.

outputEveryS.description: Result interval in seconds (default: every increment). Excludes outputTimesS.

outputTimesS.description: Result times in seconds, strictly increasing within (0, endTimeS]. Excludes outputEveryS.

name: set_thermal_step

description: Set (or remove) the thread of a hole feature made by add_hole: a designation such as "MJ6x1-4H5H" or ".1900-32 UNJF-3B", checked against a light per-family grammar. By default it is a cosmetic attribute for drawings, hole_table and code export; the geometry and the shape recipe key are NOT changed. With thread.modelled true the part is rebuilt with a real helical groove (basic 60 degree internal profile, explicit pitch required, bore near the minor diameter; needs a geometry kernel). featureIndex counts the hole/pocket features of the part in the order they were cut (0 = first add_hole or add_pocket on the original solid); hole ids in hole_table read hole-<featureIndex>.<position>. Refusal codes: FTR_PART_NOT_FOUND, FTR_THREAD_DESIGNATION_INVALID, FTR_HOLE_DIAMETERS_INCONSISTENT, FTR_NEEDS_EXACT_KERNEL, FTR_FEATURE_BUILD_FAILED.

featureIndex.description: Index of the hole feature among the part features (add_hole / add_pocket steps in cutting order, from 0).

id.description: Id of the mesh entity made by add_hole.

thread.description: The thread to set, or null to remove it. designation is checked against its family grammar; depth is in document length units.

depth.description: Threaded depth, in document length units. Omit for the full hole depth.

designation.description: Thread designation, e.g. "MJ6x1-4H5H", ".1900-32 UNJF-3B", "M6x1-6H", "1/4-20 UNC-2B". Cosmetic unless modelled is true.

family.description: Thread family (UNJ, MJ, UN, M, other). Omit to infer it from the designation.

modelled.description: true cuts a real helical thread groove (basic 60 degree internal ISO 68-1 profile; M / MJ / UN / UNJ designations with an explicit pitch, e.g. "M6x1"; MJ / UNJ root radius not applied, unverified) into the hole: the bore diameter must be about the minor diameter (D - 1.0825 P) and below the major diameter; needs a geometry kernel; changes the geometry and the shape recipe key. Omit or false = cosmetic, no geometry.

name: set_thread

description: Change what a topology study minimises: min_compliance (the stiffest layout within volumeFraction, the default) or min_volume (the least material whose weighted compliance stays at or below maxCompliance, given in the force x length unit of the analysis unit system, e.g. N*mm; read a solved min_compliance report to pick it). min_volume needs the MMA optimizer, so settings.optimizer switches to mma. loadCaseWeights apply to both objectives (a case not listed weighs 1). A recorded result becomes stale: re-run topology_solve.

kind.description: Minimise the weighted compliance (maximise stiffness) within the volume fraction.

loadCaseWeights.description: Weight of each load case name in the weighted compliance; a case not listed weighs 1.

kind.description: Minimise the material while the weighted compliance stays at or below maxCompliance (needs optimizer mma).

loadCaseWeights.description: Weight of each load case name in the weighted compliance; a case not listed weighs 1.

maxCompliance.description: Largest allowed weighted compliance, in the force x length unit of the analysis unit system (N-mm-t-s: N*mm), > 0.

objective.description: min_compliance (stiffest within volumeFraction) or min_volume (least material with compliance <= maxCompliance).

studyId.description: Id of the topology study (affected[0] of create_topology_study, e.g. ts-3.1).

name: set_topology_objective

description: Set the regions of a topology study that must stay solid (keepIn: interfaces, bolt bosses, loaded faces) or must stay empty (keepOut: clearances, routing). Each list you give REPLACES the existing one; omit a list to keep it. A region is a box (world coordinates), another solid (entity) or the voxel layers next to a face / edge / point of a part (target, depthVoxels). Refused when a region does not touch the design domain (TOP_REGION_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN), when keep-in and keep-out overlap, or when the keep-in volume alone reaches the volume budget (TOP_KEEPIN_EXCEEDS_BUDGET: raise volumeFraction or shrink the keep-in regions). Load and support layers are protected automatically (settings.protectLoadSupport), you do not add them here. A recorded result becomes stale.

keepIn.description: Regions that stay solid (replaces the existing keepIn list; [] clears it).

kind.description: All voxels whose centre lies in an axis-aligned box.

max.description: Box maximum corner [x, y, z], world coordinates in document units.

min.description: Box minimum corner [x, y, z], world coordinates in document units.

entityId.description: Id of an existing 3D solid.

kind.description: All voxels whose centre lies inside another solid (an interface boss, a bolt boss, a keep-out volume).

depthVoxels.description: Layers of voxels next to the target, at least 1. Default 1.

kind.description: The layers of voxels next to a face / edge / point of a part (a bearing seat, a loaded face).

target.description: Same targets as add_fea_constraint: points that identify faces / edges / points of a design-domain entity.

edgesNear.description: Points identifying edges: each resolves to the nearest edge.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended edge.

entityId.description: Id of the analysed 3D entity (it must be a part of the analysis: set_part_idealization).

facesNear.description: Points identifying faces: each resolves to the NEAREST face of the entity at meshing time.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended face.

pointsNear.description: Points identifying vertices / locations: each resolves to the nearest vertex or node.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended vertex or location.

keepOut.description: Regions that stay empty (replaces the existing keepOut list; [] clears it).

kind.description: All voxels whose centre lies in an axis-aligned box.

max.description: Box maximum corner [x, y, z], world coordinates in document units.

min.description: Box minimum corner [x, y, z], world coordinates in document units.

entityId.description: Id of an existing 3D solid.

kind.description: All voxels whose centre lies inside another solid (an interface boss, a bolt boss, a keep-out volume).

depthVoxels.description: Layers of voxels next to the target, at least 1. Default 1.

kind.description: The layers of voxels next to a face / edge / point of a part (a bearing seat, a loaded face).

target.description: Same targets as add_fea_constraint: points that identify faces / edges / points of a design-domain entity.

edgesNear.description: Points identifying edges: each resolves to the nearest edge.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended edge.

entityId.description: Id of the analysed 3D entity (it must be a part of the analysis: set_part_idealization).

facesNear.description: Points identifying faces: each resolves to the NEAREST face of the entity at meshing time.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended face.

pointsNear.description: Points identifying vertices / locations: each resolves to the nearest vertex or node.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended vertex or location.

studyId.description: Id of the topology study (affected[0] of create_topology_study, e.g. ts-3.1).

name: set_topology_regions

description: Change the optimizer settings of a topology study; only the values you give change, each is stored as chosen (not a default). Ranges: penal [1, 5], eminRatio (0, 1), move (0, 1], changeTol > 0, maxIterations 1..10000, filter radius > 0 in document length units, threshold and greyLimit (0, 1). filter.kind sensitivity is the classic top88 filter (default); density gives smoother boundaries and allows a Heaviside projection (projection: crisp 0/1 layouts; null removes it). optimizer oc (default) or mma (needed by min_volume and advised with gravity). manufacturing: symmetry planes (mirrored derived geometry), extrusion (design uniform along a world axis), minMemberSize (raises the filter radius to half of it; at least 2 voxels, else TOP_MEMBER_SIZE_UNRESOLVED). protectLoadSupport false reproduces the Andreassen top88 benchmark. A recorded result becomes stale when a solver setting (anything but greyLimit) changes.

changeTol.description: Stop when the largest design change of an iteration is at most this, > 0. Default 0.01.

eminRatio.description: Void stiffness as a fraction of the solid stiffness, in (0, 1). Default 1e-9.

kind.description: sensitivity (default) or density filter.

radius.description: Filter radius in document length units, > 0. Default 1.5 voxels. Below 1 voxel the filter does nothing.

greyLimit.description: Mean grey level (4 x (1 - x)) above which check_topology warns, in (0, 1). Default 0.1.

manufacturing.description: Manufacturing constraints; the object you give REPLACES the current one. Each is listed by topology_report.rules.

extrusion.description: Keep the design uniform along one world axis (one design variable per column of voxels): parts cut from plate or extruded.

axis.description: World axis the design is uniform along.

minMemberSize.description: Smallest member allowed, document length units, at least 2 voxels: the filter radius is raised to half of it (llull rule rmin >= size / 2).

symmetry.description: Planes through the domain centre across which the density field is mirrored in the derived geometry.

move.description: Move limit per iteration (OC and MMA), in (0, 1]. Default 0.2.

optimizer.description: oc (optimality criteria, default: one volume constraint, non-positive sensitivities) or mma (method of moving asymptotes: min_volume, gravity, several constraints).

penal.description: SIMP penalisation power p, in [1, 5]. Default 3.
