normal.description: Plane normal (need not be unit length).

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended vertex or location.

name.description: New display name.

referencePoint.description: moment only: point [x, y, z] in document units the moment acts about; the Nastran BDF export puts an RBE3 reference node there. Default: the centroid of the target nodes. The CalculiX deck applies a pure couple, which has no reference point, so it ignores this.

target.description: force / pressure / moment: the faces (edges, points for force) the load acts on. A moment needs a face, an edge or at least three points. Not for gravity.

edgesNear.description: Points identifying edges: each resolves to the nearest edge.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended edge.

entityId.description: Id of the analysed 3D entity (it must be a part of the analysis: set_part_idealization).

facesNear.description: Points identifying faces: each resolves to the NEAREST face of the entity at meshing time.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended face.

intersectPlane.description: Optional: restrict the target to the curve where the faces meet this plane.

normal.description: Plane normal (need not be unit length).

pointsNear.description: Points identifying vertices / locations: each resolves to the nearest vertex or node.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended vertex or location.

vector.description: force / gravity: direction and magnitude [x, y, z]; moment: the moment vector [mx, my, mz] by the right-hand rule in force x length of the unit system (N-mm-t-s: N.mm, N-m-kg-s: N.m, lbf-in-slinch-s: lbf.in) (in the case unitSystem: N-mm-t-s -> N, MPa, mm/s^2 (9.81 m/s^2 = 9810); N-m-kg-s -> N, Pa, m/s^2; lbf-in-slinch-s -> lbf, psi, in/s^2). Not for pressure.

description: Change one or more properties of a layer: rename it (name), show or hide it (visible; hidden layers are not rendered), lock or unlock it (locked; entities on a locked layer cannot be reassigned via set_entity_layer, but geometry edits are not blocked), or tint it (color). Give at least one field; fields not given are kept. Entities are not affected. Graceful no-op if the layer id does not exist, no field is given, the name is empty or the color is not #rrggbb.

name.description: New display name for the layer. Must be non-empty.

visible.description: true to make the layer visible; false to hide it.

description: Rename a level or change its elevation / floor-to-floor height. All walls, slabs, columns, beams, stairs, doors, windows and rooms on the level move and regenerate accordingly; walls and columns at full storey height and stairs climbing the storey follow a new height.

height.description: New floor-to-floor height (> 0, document units).

levelId.description: Level id, e.g. "level-2".

name.description: New level name; blank keeps the current name.

description: Change fields of a load history (name, unit, data, repeats, source); omitted fields keep their value. The merged history must be valid (see define_load_history). Fatigue and crack-growth cases that use the history see the new values on their next compute.

form.description: A sampled / reversal series in time order.

values.description: At least 2 finite values in the history unit, in time order (peaks and valleys are extracted on use).

form.description: Constant-amplitude blocks: each row is a cycle between max and min repeated `cycles` times.

cycles.description: Number of repetitions of this cycle per block, > 0.

max.description: Maximum of the cycle, history unit.

min.description: Minimum of the cycle (<= max), history unit.

name.description: New display name.

source.description: New provenance.

citation.description: Where the history comes from (measurement, standard, spectrum name). Mandatory, non-empty.

unit.description: New unit (must match the kind).

description: Edit a manhole: move it, change invert / rim (or re-take the rim from `surfaceId`), diameter, catchment (`catchmentAreaHa` 0 removes it), point inflow (0 removes it), `entryTimeMin` or name. Connected pipes stay connected and keep their inverts; pipes whose invert would fall below the new manhole invert are reported.

catchmentAreaHa.description: Contributing catchment area in hectares (> 0) for the rational method.

diameter.description: Chamber internal diameter in document units (> 0). Default 1200 mm.

entryTimeMin.description: Inlet (entry) time in minutes (> 0) of this manhole's catchment for the time of concentration. Default 5.

inflowLps.description: Additional point inflow in litres per second (>= 0).

invertElevation.description: Invert (lowest internal) elevation of the chamber.

name.description: Display name. Default "MH<n>".

rimElevation.description: Rim (cover level) elevation; must be above the invert. Overrides `surfaceId`.

runoffCoefficient.description: Runoff coefficient C, 0 to 1. Default 0.9 when a catchment area is given.

surfaceId.description: Surface id; when `rimElevation` is omitted the rim is the ground level there.

name: update_manhole

description: Change a nozzle of an equipment in place, keeping its mark and port id "<tag>:<mark>": any of service, dn / nps, rating, facing, location (same forms as add_nozzle, replaces the whole location) and projection. Fields you omit are unchanged. The nozzle is re-validated against the body and its flange re-resolved from the piping catalogue. Returns the new world position and direction of the port. Refusals as add_nozzle, plus EQP_NOZZLE_NOT_FOUND.

angleConvention.description: How angles in this call are read and reported. north_cw (default): vertical equipment 0 = plant north (+Y), growing clockwise seen from above (90 = east, +X); horizontal equipment 0 = top (+Z), 90 = the +Y side; a plan rotation grows clockwise. east_ccw: CAD maths, 0 = east (+X), growing counter-clockwise; horizontal equipment 0 = +Y, 90 = top; a plan rotation grows counter-clockwise. Every result names the convention.

dn.description: Nominal size DN (15..600 of the EN 10220 series). Give dn OR nps.

equipment.description: Equipment tag (e.g. "V-101", the element mark) or element id (e.g. "equipment-3").

location.description: Where the nozzle sits. Only the fields of the chosen `on` are read.

direction.description: free: outward direction of the nozzle axis [dx, dy, dz] in the equipment frame; normalised.

elevation.description: shell, vertical vessel: height above the bottom tangent line, 0..tangentLength.

head.description: head: top / bottom for a vertical vessel, left / right for a horizontal one.

on.description: shell: on the cylinder (vertical vessel: elevation; horizontal vessel: station). head: on a formed head (top / bottom or left / right) at radialOffset. free: any equipment, including plain add_equipment blocks and pumps: position + direction in the equipment frame.

orientationDeg.description: shell / head: angle around the vessel axis in degrees, read with angleConvention. Default 0 (north / top).

position.description: free: flange face centre [x, y, z] in the equipment frame (origin = plan location at the level elevation, +Z up).

radialOffset.description: head: distance of the nozzle axis from the vessel axis, 0 = on the axis (default), below the inside radius.

station.description: shell, horizontal vessel: distance from the left tangent line, 0..tangentLength.

mark.description: Mark of the nozzle to change.

nps.description: Nominal pipe size in inches, e.g. 6 or "2-1/2"; converted to DN. Give dn OR nps.

projection.description: Distance to the flange FACE: shell nozzles from the vessel axis, head nozzles from the tangent line, free nozzles the neck length behind position. Document units.

rating.description: Flange rating: CL150, CL300, CL600 ... or PN16, PN40 ...

name: update_nozzle

description: Edit a door or window: slide it along its wall (offset), resize it, change sill height, swing, material or mark. The host wall is re-cut.

height.description: New height in document units (> 0).

mark.description: New schedule mark, unique among doors / windows of the same kind; blank keeps the current one.

material.description: New material; blank keeps the current one.

offset.description: New distance from the wall start to the opening center, in document units.

sillHeight.description: New sill height above the level floor, in document units (>= 0).

width.description: New width in document units (> 0).

name: update_opening

description: Change a pipe line (create_pipeline) and re-derive its runs: service, sequence, spec, line number, design conditions, insulation, slope, from / to text. A new spec re-selects every part of the line (elbows, flanges, gaskets, valves, tees) from that spec and its catalogues, and the cut lengths follow; the change is refused whole (nothing changes) when the new spec cannot build one of the runs (missing component, bend angle, leg too short, rating or size of a port). A line number that followed the document template (set_piping_settings; default DN-service-sequence-spec[-insulation]) follows it again; an explicit line number is kept unless you pass lineNumber. The size (dn) cannot change: create another line. Omitted fields stay; from / to "" clear the text; insulation null removes the insulation and slope null the declared slope. Insulation read from the spec table ("fromSpec") is read again when the spec or designTempC changes. Returns the line id (affected[0]); data = { lineId, lineNumber, changed (field names), specChanged, rederivedRuns, insulation, unverified }. Refusals: RTE_UNKNOWN_LINE, RTE_SPEC_UNKNOWN, RTE_SPEC_NO_COMPONENT (no pipe row for the dn, no insulation row), RTE_SLOPE_INVALID, RTE_DUPLICATE_LINE_NUMBER, and the RTE_* code of the first run that no longer derives. Next: check_piping, piping_takeoff.

from.description: From tag text for the line list; "" clears it.

insulation.description: New insulation { code, thickness (mm | "fromSpec"), material? }; null removes it.

code.description: Insulation code written in the line number, e.g. 'H' (hot).

material.description: Insulation material; default from the spec table row, else unnamed.

thickness.description: Thickness in mm, or "fromSpec" to read the spec insulation table (needs designTempC and a table row for the code, DN and temperature).

lineNumber.description: Explicit line number (unique); otherwise the template when the old number followed it.

slope.description: New declared slope of the line; null removes it.

fall.description: true = the pipe descends along the flow (a drain); false = it rises along the flow.

unit.description: "percent" (1 = 1 %), "ratio" (drop / plan length, 0.01) or "deg".

value.description: Slope size, > 0: percent of the plan length (1 = 1 %), a ratio (0.01) or degrees, per unit. At most 45 degrees (100 %).

spec.description: Id of another piping spec already in the document (list_pipe_specs), e.g. 'CS300'.

to.description: To tag text for the line list; "" clears it.

name: update_pipeline

description: Edit a graded platform: change its finished level, outline, batter slopes or name. Geometry and volumes are regenerated; returns data { platformId, cutM3, fillM3, netM3 }. Only the given fields change; the call is a no-op when nothing differs.

boundary.description: New pad outline (>= 3 vertices, simple polygon, inside the surface).

items.description: Pad outline vertex [x, y].

name.description: New name.

description: Edit one PMI item by id. Each kind takes only its own fields: datum_feature (label, facesNear), datum_target (targetNumber, areaSize, facesNear), size_dimension (tolerance, sizeModifiers, facesNear), location_dimension (tolerance), geometric_tolerance (zone, materialCondition, modifiers, datums, facesNear), surface_texture (parameter, value, unit, lay, process, facesNear), note (text, facesNear); any kind takes placement (explicit annotation plane, kept) or autoPlacement: true (recompute). facesNear re-attaches the item to the faces at those points (needs the OCC kernel); other edits keep the faces and refresh derived data when a kernel is present. Renaming a datum label rewrites the frames that reference it. The edited item needs review again. Refusals: GDT_PMI_UNKNOWN, GDT_FIELD_INVALID_FOR_KIND, GDT_DATUM_DUPLICATE, GDT_LIMITS_INVERTED and the add_* rule codes; unchanged values are a no-op.

areaSize.description: datum_target: new area diameter, document units.

autoPlacement.description: true = recompute the automatic annotation placement.

facesNear.description: World points, one per face of the feature (document units). The faces are re-found from these points at every replay, so PMI follows its face through parametric edits. A pattern of equal holes takes one point on each hole. Use inspect_faces to find points on faces.

items.description: One world point [x, y, z] ON the face (document units), e.g. a point from inspect_faces centroid or samples.

label.description: datum_feature: new datum letter(s), unique on the solid.

placement.description: Optional explicit annotation placement; omit for the automatic plane (recomputed when the model changes). An explicit placement is kept.

leaderTo.description: Optional leader attachment point on the feature [x, y, z].

normal.description: Annotation plane unit normal [x, y, z].

origin.description: Annotation plane origin [x, y, z], document units.

position.description: Frame centre in plane coordinates [u, v], document units.

xDir.description: Annotation plane x direction [x, y, z] (unit, perpendicular to normal).

pmiId.description: Id of the PMI item to edit (from list_pmi or the add_* affected id).

sizeModifiers.description: size_dimension: replacement ISO 14405 modifier list ([] clears).

lower.description: Lower deviation (<= upper), e.g. 0 or -0.05. Document length units (degrees for an angle).

type.description: Deviations from the measured nominal.

upper.description: Upper deviation (>= lower), e.g. 0.021. Document length units (degrees for an angle).

lower.description: Lower limit of size, e.g. 6.6. Document length units (degrees for an angle).

type.description: Absolute limits of size.

upper.description: Upper limit of size (>= lower), e.g. 6.9. Document length units (degrees for an angle).

lower.description: Lower deviation from the nominal for that code. Document length units (degrees for an angle).

type.description: ISO fit class code as text with its explicit deviations (no ISO 286 table is shipped).

upper.description: Upper deviation from the nominal for that code. Document length units (degrees for an angle).

type.description: Theoretically exact dimension, shown boxed, no tolerance.

tolerance.description: Tolerance as { type: "plusMinus", upper, lower } deviations, { type: "limits", upper, lower } absolute limits, { type: "fit", code, upper, lower } or { type: "basic" }.

unit.description: surface_texture: um or uin.

value.description: Tolerance zone width or diameter, document units; > 0.

cloudId.description: Id of an attached cloud (affected[0] of attach_point_cloud, e.g. "cloud-1.1").

normal.description: Plane normal (need not be unit length).

pointsNear.description: Points identifying vertices / locations: each resolves to the nearest vertex or node.

items.description: A point [x, y, z] in document units lying on (or very near) the intended vertex or location.

description: Verify a STEP (AP203 / AP214 / AP242) or IGES file before using it: file schema, length unit with its exact factor to millimetres (25.4 for inch), entity census (PMI, tessellation, B-rep and assembly types for STEP; entity types and untranslated types for IGES) and the geometric validation properties the sender embedded (volume, surface area, centre point per product, converted to millimetres). With the exact OCC kernel the file is also imported (nothing is stored) and the embedded properties are compared with the recomputed ones per product: band green (<= 1e-3 relative) / yellow (<= 1e-2 and 1 mm) / red / not-checkable (sender gave none or all zero). Without a kernel only the file claims are reported. Returns data.issues[] with XCH_* codes and a remediation each. Give the file as text or stepBase64 (IGES too). Does not modify the document.

fileName.description: Original file name, echoed in the report.

format.description: File format. Default: detected from the content.

gvpPolicy.description: Band limits; each omitted limit keeps its default.

greenCentroidPerDiag.description: Green centroid distance as a fraction of the bounding-box diagonal. Default 1e-3.

greenRel.description: Largest relative volume / area difference still green. Default 1e-3.

yellowCentroidMm.description: Largest centroid distance still yellow, in millimetres. Default 1.

yellowRel.description: Largest relative difference still yellow. Default 1e-2.

stepBase64.description: The file bytes, base64 encoded (ASCII text). Give exactly one of text or stepBase64.

text.description: The file content (Part 21 or IGES text). Give exactly one of text or stepBase64.

Returns data { contentHashMatches, liveDefinitionMatches, signaturesValid, titleBlockConsistent, reconstructedFrom }. Read-only. Regenerating geometry to compare fingerprints is not implemented yet.

description: Query: inside volume of a cylindrical vessel with two formed heads, and the liquid volume at given levels (closed forms of D. Jones, tank-volume geometry). Give EITHER `equipment` (tag or id of a vessel from add_vessel; its design.operatingLiquid is also reported as `operating`) OR the vessel inline: orientation, insideDiameter, tangentLength and the two heads (ellipsoidal 2:1, torispherical by standard or radii, hemispherical, flat, conical). Levels count up from the lowest inside point: the apex of the first (bottom) head for a vertical vessel, the bottom of the shell for a horizontal one. Lengths are in document units; volumes are returned in m3. Nozzle bores, trays and other internals are not subtracted. Returns totalVolumeM3, insideHeight, headDepths, levels[{ level, liquidVolumeM3, percent }], operating (equipment form with an operating liquid: { levelAboveBottomTangent, liquidVolumeM3, percent, liquidMassKg }), method, assumptions, sources and unverified (true when a grade B/C head standard was used). Refusals: EQP_NOT_FOUND, EQP_NOT_PARAMETRIC, EQP_PARAM_INVALID, EQP_HEAD_INVALID, EQP_LEVEL_OUT_OF_RANGE, EQP_HEAD_NOT_COVERED (horizontal torispherical heads at a partial level, V1). Does not modify the document.

equipment.description: Tag or id of a vessel. Replaces the inline description below.

heads.description: Inline form: the two formed heads.

crownRadius.description: torispherical only: crown (dish) radius in document units, with knuckleRadius.

halfAngleDeg.description: conical only: half apex angle between the axis and the cone surface, degrees.

knuckleRadius.description: torispherical only: knuckle radius in document units, with crownRadius.

ratio.description: ellipsoidal only: inside diameter / (2 x inside depth). 2 = standard 2:1 head.

standard.description: torispherical only: asme_fd (crown = D, knuckle 6 % D), asme_80_10, asme_80_6, din_28011 (Kloepper), din_28013 (Korbbogen). The proportions are applied to the inside diameter you give. Rows below grade A make the result report unverified.

thickness.description: flat only: plate thickness in document units (not used by volumes).

type.description: Head type. ellipsoidal: needs ratio (2 = 2:1 semi-ellipsoidal, depth = D/4). torispherical: needs standard OR crownRadius + knuckleRadius. hemispherical: depth = D/2. flat: depth 0. conical: needs halfAngleDeg (apex half-angle from the axis, 0..90 exclusive).

description: Merge cage vertices into one: without `tolerance` all given `vertices` become a single vertex; with `tolerance` (document units) only vertices closer than that to each other merge (clusters). The survivor is the lowest-index vertex of the cluster and keeps its id; it stays where it is, or moves to the cluster centre with `toCentre`. Faces that touch the cluster lose the repeated corner (a quad becomes a triangle, a digon disappears); sharp edges and corners follow. Use it to collapse an edge, to stitch two boundary edges of an open cage, or to clean a cage. A symmetric cage welds the mirror clusters too. Refuses a weld that makes the surface non-manifold (DIR_WELD_NONMANIFOLD, e.g. opposite corners of a cube). Returns data { vertexCount, faceCount, vertices, vertexIds, faceIds, welded, removedVertices, removedFaces }. Next: check_subdivision.

id.description: Id of the subdivision solid.

toCentre.description: true: the merged vertex moves to the centre of its cluster. Default false (it stays at the first vertex).

tolerance.description: Document units: merge only vertices at most this far apart (clusters). Omit to merge all given vertices into one.

vertices.description: Vertices to merge, as ids or indices (at least 2).

items.description: A cage vertex: element id ("v-1.7", stable across topology edits) or current index.

name: weld_cage_vertices

description: Read-only planform and volume figures of a wing made with create_wing, from its definition (no kernel needed): semi-span, planform area per side and of the complete symmetric wing (areaRef), aspect ratio (2 * semi-span)^2 / areaRef, taper ratio, mean aerodynamic chord MAC with its spanwise position yMac and leading-edge x xLeMac, leading-edge / quarter-chord / trailing-edge sweep root to tip in degrees, and the volume from the section areas (exact for one airfoil along the wing, an estimate when airfoils differ). Areas and volumes are in document units squared / cubed; angles in degrees. `unverified` is true when an airfoil input has no pinned source.

id.description: Wing id (affected[0] of create_wing).

name: wing_properties

description: Wrap 2D sketch entities onto a face of a solid as curves lying on that face. Method develop (default) keeps every length (the face is unrolled like paper) and works on plane, cylinder and cone faces; on a sphere or torus it refuses with WRP_FACE_NOT_DEVELOPABLE. Method geodesic wraps by the exponential map about the anchor (radial lengths exact, circumferential ones stretch by sin(rho / R) / (rho / R) on a sphere); method parametric scales (u, v) by the arc-length rates at the anchor; both work on sphere and torus faces and report data.distortion { maxLengthStrain, meanLengthStrain, areaRatio, worst } and refuse above maxLengthStrain (WRP_DISTORTION_EXCEEDED). Freeform faces are not built (WRP_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE). `entityIds` are sketch curves (line, arc, circle, rectangle, polyline, spline ...) or text created with a font (each glyph contour becomes a curve). `placement` puts a sketch point on a face point (anchor), turns the sketch (angleDeg) and may mirror it; the chart x axis follows the circumference (cylinder: +azimuth about the axis) and y the axis. Each closed loop and open chain becomes one nurbs_curve entity with its pcurve (`onFace`). The result lists per curve length3d (document units), chartLength, maxLengthStrain and fitTolerance, and data.distortion. A sketch wider than one turn refuses with WRP_WRAP_OVERLAP (data shows the full-turn width), a curve leaving the face with WRP_OUTSIDE_FACE. Needs the exact (native) kernel. Next: emboss_on_face, check_wrap, render_view.

entityIds.description: Ids of the 2D sketch entities (or font texts) to wrap.

face.description: The face to work on: give faceNear (a point on the face), or faceIndex, or faceName. The command records the face name so a later edit of the model finds the same face (REF_LOST when it is gone).

faceIndex.description: Unique face index of the solid (inspect_faces / inspect_topology list them).

faceName.description: Persistent face name recorded by an earlier run of this command; wins over faceIndex and faceNear.

faceNear.description: A point on or near the intended face [x, y, z] in world document units; the face nearest to it is taken.

fitTolerance.description: Largest deviation of a fitted 3D curve from its exact image, document units. Default: 1e-6 x the solid diagonal (named default).

id.description: Id of the solid whose face carries the curves.

maxLengthStrain.description: Largest accepted relative length change of a geodesic or parametric chart (1 = 100 %). Default 0.02 (named default); develop faces have none.

placement.description: Sketch-to-face placement. Chart axes: x follows the circumference (cylinder / cone: +azimuth about the axis from the face x direction; plane: the face x direction), y follows the axis (cone: away from the apex along the generator; plane: normal x x direction). Lengths and angles are kept (develop).

anchor.description: Where the sketch sits on the face: sketch point `chart` lands on face point `on`.

chart.description: Sketch point [x, y] (sketch plane document units) that lands on `on`. Default [0, 0].

on.description: Point [x, y, z] on the face where the sketch point lands. Default: the point of the face nearest to faceNear (else the face centroid).

angleDeg.description: Turn of the sketch in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from outside the face, from the face reference direction (cylinder / cone: around the axis, +azimuth; plane: the face x direction). Default 0.

method.description: How the sketch is carried onto the face. develop (default) keeps every length and angle and works on plane, cylinder and cone faces (Gaussian curvature 0). geodesic, parametric and project are not built yet (WRP_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE); a sphere or freeform face is WRP_FACE_NOT_DEVELOPABLE with develop.

mirror.description: Flip the sketch y axis (a wrap seen from inside). Default false.

name: wrap_to_face
